article_content: Ryanair's boss, Michael O’Leary, has pledged to improve customer service and eliminate the airline’s ‘macho’ culture. Speaking at the budget airline’s annual shareholder meeting in Dublin, the CEO addressed concerns that customer service issues were negatively impacting sales. He stated that the airline must improve its treatment of passengers and complaint handling. Mr. O'Leary was compelled to issue an apology after a grieving father, Muhammad Taufiq Sattar, was charged £160 to change his flight home following the tragic death of his family in a suspected arson attack. Dr. Sattar had to pay nearly £160 to change his Ryanair flight from Dublin to the UK after being informed that his family had likely perished. ‘I don’t want to overstate this, but I was shocked. I didn't expect to be charged,’ Dr. Sattar said. ‘Given the circumstances, I thought they might allow me to transfer flights, as I had already purchased a return ticket.’ Addressing criticism about his perceived rudeness, Mr. O'Leary told shareholders, ‘We should try to eliminate things that unnecessarily annoy people.’ Regarding common complaints, such as charges for slightly oversized hand luggage, he noted, ‘A lot of those customer service elements don’t cost a lot of money’. Ryanair will review its strict rules on luggage and high charges for customers who fail to print their boarding passes. Plans were revealed to enhance the airline’s website and establish a communications unit for quicker responses to customer complaints via Twitter and texts. ‘I am willing to accept responsibility if we have a macho or abrupt culture,’ he stated. ‘Some of that may stem from my own character.’ Ryanair was recently ranked as having the worst customer service among Britain's top hundred brands by Which?. This cultural shift announcement follows a series of negative headlines for the budget airline. Dr. Sattar's experience corroborates this poor assessment; he was forced to pay for a new flight to return to the UK after his family died in a fire in Leicester. Upon arriving at Dublin Airport around 5:30 am, shortly after Leicester Police confirmed the deaths, Dr. Sattar approached the Ryanair check-in desk to request a ticket change. Despite explaining his situation, he was informed that he needed to purchase a new ticket. The neurosurgeon paid €187.46 (approximately £158) for a one-way ticket to Birmingham. Mr. O’Leary confirmed that a letter of condolence and an apology had been sent to Dr. Sattar for the airline’s handling of the situation. 'I believe exceptions should be made in cases like that, and we made an exception last night when we became aware of it,' Mr. O’Leary said. 'We want to respond sensitively to these cases.' Dr. Sattar received a refund for the extra charge, and Mr. O’Leary stated that the initial booking change was processed according to company policy, which staff are instructed to follow without deviation. Ryanair previously warned that annual profits might fall short of or reach the lower end of its projected range of €570 million to €600 million. The airline also reported a decrease in ticket prices and booking volumes for September, October, and November.
translated_content: Šéf spoločnosti Ryanair, Michael O’Leary, prisľúbil zlepšiť zákaznícky servis a odstrániť „macho“ kultúru v leteckej spoločnosti. Na výročnej schôdzi akcionárov tejto nízkonákladovej leteckej spoločnosti v Dubline generálny riaditeľ reagoval na obavy, že problémy so zákazníckym servisom negatívne ovplyvňujú predaj. Uviedol, že letecká spoločnosť musí zlepšiť prístup k cestujúcim a riešenie sťažností. Pán O'Leary bol nútený ospravedlniť sa po tom, čo smútiacemu otcovi, Muhammadovi Taufiqovi Sattarovi, bol účtovaný poplatok 160 libier za zmenu letu domov po tragickej smrti jeho rodiny pri podozrení na žhářský útok. Dr. Sattar musel zaplatiť takmer 160 libier za zmenu letu spoločnosti Ryanair z Dublinu do Spojeného kráľovstva po tom, čo bol informovaný, že jeho rodina pravdepodobne zahynula. ‘Nechcem to preháňať, ale bol som šokovaný. Nečakal som, že mi budú účtovať poplatok,’ povedal Dr. Sattar. ‘Vzhľadom na okolnosti som si myslel, že by mi mohli umožniť zmenu letu, keďže som si už kúpil spiatočný lístok.’ V reakcii na kritiku jeho vnímanej hrubosti pán O'Leary akcionárom povedal: ‘Mali by sme sa snažiť eliminovať veci, ktoré ľudí zbytočne otravujú.’ Pokiaľ ide o bežné sťažnosti, ako sú poplatky za mierne nadrozmernú príručnú batožinu, poznamenal: ‘Mnohé z týchto prvkov zákazníckeho servisu nestoja veľa peňazí’. Ryanair prehodnotí svoje prísne pravidlá týkajúce sa batožiny a vysoké poplatky pre zákazníkov, ktorí si zabudnú vytlačiť palubné vstupenky. Boli zverejnené plány na vylepšenie webovej stránky leteckej spoločnosti a vytvorenie komunikačnej jednotky pre rýchlejšie reakcie na sťažnosti zákazníkov prostredníctvom Twitteru a textových správ. ‘Som ochotný prevziať zodpovednosť, ak máme macho alebo necitlivú kultúru,’ uviedol. ‘Časť z toho môže prameniť z mojej vlastnej povahy.’ Spoločnosť Ryanair bola nedávno označená za spoločnosť s najhorším zákazníckym servisom spomedzi sto najväčších značiek v Británii podľa Which?. Toto oznámenie o kultúrnej zmene nasleduje po sérii negatívnych titulkov pre túto nízkonákladovú leteckú spoločnosť. Skúsenosť Dr. Sattara potvrdzuje toto zlé hodnotenie; bol nútený zaplatiť za nový let späť do Spojeného kráľovstva po tom, čo jeho rodina zomrela pri požiari v Leicesteri. Po príchode na letisko v Dubline okolo 5:30 ráno, krátko po tom, čo polícia v Leicesteri potvrdila úmrtia, Dr. Sattar prišiel k odbavovaciemu pultu spoločnosti Ryanair, aby požiadal o zmenu lístka. Napriek vysvetleniu svojej situácie bol informovaný, že si musí kúpiť nový lístok. Neurochirurg zaplatil 187,46 € (približne 158 £) za jednosmerný lístok do Birminghamu. Pán O’Leary potvrdil, že Dr. Sattarovi bol zaslaný kondolenčný list a ospravedlnenie za to, ako letecká spoločnosť zvládla túto situáciu. ‘Verím, že v takýchto prípadoch by sa mali robiť výnimky, a urobili sme výnimku včera večer, keď sme si to uvedomili,’ povedal pán O’Leary. ‘Chceme reagovať citlivo na tieto prípady.’ Dr. Sattar dostal vrátený poplatok navyše a pán O’Leary uviedol, že pôvodná zmena rezervácie bola spracovaná v súlade s firemnou politikou, ktorou sa zamestnanci riadia bez odchýlok. Spoločnosť Ryanair predtým varovala, že ročné zisky by mohli nedosiahnuť alebo dosiahnuť spodnú hranicu svojho plánovaného rozpätia 570 až 600 miliónov EUR. Letecká spoločnosť tiež oznámila pokles cien leteniek a objemu rezervácií za september, október a november.

article_content: On Saturday, Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner commenced her second four-year term as the President of Argentina, celebrating her nation's robust economy despite worldwide economic turmoil. 'We are a different Argentina now, existing within a changed world presenting greater challenges and requiring crucial decisions for the well-being of our citizens and society,' she stated. A significant portion of her address centered on the specifics of Argentina's economic performance, which stands out positively against the backdrop of a global economic decline. She noted that industrial expansion has generated over five million jobs during her time in office, and minimum wages are the highest in the region. Argentina's economy is projected to potentially expand by 9% in 2011, according to her statements. Domestic growth within the country served as a primary factor in sustaining the economy, she added. 'I don't need to present consumption data. Simply observing the streets in any city or town reveals that the domestic market is precisely what enabled us to overcome the crises of 2008 and 2009,' she explained. While dedicating considerable attention to specific economic metrics, Fernandez also reinforced her populist stance. 'I am not the president serving corporations,' she declared. 'I am the president of all 40 million Argentinians.' Fernandez is among Argentina's most favored leaders since the country's return to democracy. She secured re-election with over 54% of the votes cast. This presidential campaign marked her first without her deceased husband, Nestor Kirchner, a former president himself. He held the presidency from 2003 to 2007, after which Fernandez succeeded him. He passed away in October 2010. As a visible expression of grief, Fernandez wore black during the inauguration ceremony. When reciting the oath of office, she invoked God, the nation, and 'him' – referring to her late husband – to hold her accountable. She was visibly emotional as she spoke these words. 'As anyone can understand, this is a difficult day for this president,' Fernandez acknowledged. 'Despite the joy and overwhelming support in the votes, something – someone – is missing.' Her second term as president is scheduled to last until 2015.
translated_content: V sobotu Cristina Fernández de Kirchnerová začala svoje druhé štvorročné funkčné obdobie ako prezidentka Argentíny a oslavovala silnú ekonomiku svojho národa napriek celosvetovému ekonomickému chaosu. 'Sme teraz iná Argentína, existujúca v zmenenom svete, ktorý predstavuje väčšie výzvy a vyžaduje si zásadné rozhodnutia pre blaho našich občanov a spoločnosti,' uviedla. Významná časť jej prejavu sa zamerala na špecifiká argentínskej ekonomickej výkonnosti, ktorá pozitívne vyniká na pozadí globálneho hospodárskeho poklesu. Poznamenala, že priemyselná expanzia vytvorila počas jej pôsobenia vo funkcii viac ako päť miliónov pracovných miest a minimálne mzdy sú najvyššie v regióne. Argentínska ekonomika by mala potenciálne expandovať o 9 % v roku 2011, podľa jej vyjadrení. Domáci rast v krajine slúžil ako primárny faktor pri udržiavaní ekonomiky, dodala. 'Nemusím prezentovať údaje o spotrebe. Jednoduché pozorovanie ulíc v ktoromkoľvek meste alebo obci odhaľuje, že domáci trh je presne to, čo nám umožnilo prekonať krízy v rokoch 2008 a 2009,' vysvetlila. Zatiaľ čo venovala značnú pozornosť konkrétnym ekonomickým metrikám, Fernándezová tiež posilnila svoj populistický postoj. 'Nie som prezidentka, ktorá slúži korporáciám,' vyhlásila. 'Som prezidentka všetkých 40 miliónov Argentínčanov.' Fernándezová patrí medzi najobľúbenejších vodcov Argentíny od návratu krajiny k demokracii. Zabezpečila si znovuzvolenie s viac ako 54 % odovzdaných hlasov. Táto prezidentská kampaň bola jej prvou bez jej zosnulého manžela Néstora Kirchnera, bývalého prezidenta. Bol prezidentom v rokoch 2003 až 2007, po ktorom ho Fernándezová vystriedala. Zomrel v októbri 2010. Ako viditeľný prejav smútku mala Fernándezová počas inauguračného ceremoniálu oblečené čierne šaty. Pri recitovaní prísahy sa odvolala na Boha, národ a 'jeho' – s odkazom na svojho zosnulého manžela –, aby ju niesli na zodpovednosti. Pri vyslovení týchto slov bola viditeľne dojatá. 'Ako každý chápe, je to pre túto prezidentku ťažký deň,' priznala Fernándezová. 'Napriek radosti a ohromnej podpore v hlasoch niečo – niekto – chýba.' Jej druhé funkčné obdobie prezidentky má trvať do roku 2015.

article_content: Islamabad, Pakistan (CNN) -- Heavy rains and flooding in Pakistan's southeastern Sindh province have killed approximately 226 people over the past month, the National Disaster Management Authority reported on Tuesday. The fatalities include 34 children and 59 women, according to the agency's summary. Overall, an estimated 5.3 million people have been impacted by the flooding, with about 1.19 million homes damaged, the authority stated. The flooding has submerged more than 4.5 million acres, resulting in an estimated 80% loss of crops. And the heavy rains are expected to continue. 'Meteorological conditions indicate that a strong weather system is developing over central parts of India, which will likely cause widespread heavy rains in Pakistan during the coming week,' stated a weather advisory on the disaster agency's website. 'Heavy to very heavy rainfall may trigger severe flooding in lower Sindh,' along with potential flash flooding in Punjab, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, and Balochistan provinces, the advisory noted. The United Nations is arranging to provide food supplies to half a million people in Sindh for the next month and plans to supply 20,000 tents this week, the state-run Associated Press of Pakistan reported on Monday. A U.N. team is visiting Pakistan following a phone conversation between Pakistani President Asif Ali Zardari and U.N. Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon, the news agency reported. Aid is also arriving from other countries. On Monday, the Chinese ambassador to Pakistan presented a $50,000 check to the National Disaster Management Authority and has pledged an additional $4.7 million in aid to the flooded areas, including tents, according to the authority's website. Additionally, Iran's Interior Minister, Mostafa Mohammad Najar, announced on Sunday that Iran will donate $100 million in aid to Sindh, the Associated Press of Pakistan reported. Najar mentioned he will personally deliver a planeload of relief goods to Pakistan within a week. Furthermore, Pakistan's Finance Division has established a Prime Minister's Relief Fund for flood victims in Sindh and other affected regions, as reported by the Associated Press of Pakistan. Donations can be made by both domestic and international donors, the report stated. CNN's Nasir Habib and Aliza Kassim contributed to this report.
translated_content: Islamabad, Pakistan (CNN) -- Silné dažde a záplavy v juhovýchodnej pakistanskej provincii Sindh si za posledný mesiac vyžiadali približne 226 obetí, informoval v utorok Národný úrad pre riadenie katastrof. Medzi obeťami je 34 detí a 59 žien, uvádza sa v súhrne agentúry. Celkovo bolo záplavami postihnutých približne 5,3 milióna ľudí a poškodených bolo približne 1,19 milióna domov, uviedol úrad. Záplavy zatopili viac ako 4,5 milióna akrov, čo spôsobilo odhadovanú 80% stratu úrody. A očakáva sa, že silné dažde budú pokračovať. 'Meteorologické podmienky naznačujú, že sa nad centrálnymi časťami Indie vyvíja silný poveternostný systém, ktorý pravdepodobne spôsobí rozsiahle silné dažde v Pakistane počas nadchádzajúceho týždňa,' uvádza sa v meteorologickej správe na webovej stránke agentúry pre katastrofy. 'Silné až veľmi silné zrážky môžu vyvolať rozsiahle záplavy v dolnom Sindh,' spolu s potenciálnymi prívalovými povodňami v provinciách Punjab, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa a Balochistan, uvádza sa v správe. Organizácia Spojených národov zabezpečuje dodávky potravín pre pol milióna ľudí v Sindh na nasledujúci mesiac a plánuje tento týždeň dodať 20 000 stanov, informovala v pondelok štátna tlačová agentúra Associated Press of Pakistan. Tím OSN navštevuje Pakistan po telefonickom rozhovore medzi pakistanským prezidentom Asifom Alim Zardarim a generálnym tajomníkom OSN Pan Ki-munom, informovala tlačová agentúra. Pomoc prichádza aj z ďalších krajín. V pondelok čínsky veľvyslanec v Pakistane odovzdal Národnému úradu pre riadenie katastrof šek na 50 000 dolárov a prisľúbil ďalších 4,7 milióna dolárov na pomoc zaplaveným oblastiam, vrátane stanov, uvádza sa na webovej stránke úradu. Okrem toho iránsky minister vnútra Mostafa Mohammad Najar v nedeľu oznámil, že Irán daruje provincii Sindh pomoc vo výške 100 miliónov dolárov, informovala agentúra Associated Press of Pakistan. Najar uviedol, že osobne doručí do Pakistanu lietadlo plné humanitárnej pomoci do týždňa. Okrem toho pakistanské ministerstvo financií zriadilo Fond predsedu vlády pre obete záplav v Sindh a ďalších postihnutých regiónoch, ako informovala agentúra Associated Press of Pakistan. Dary môžu poskytovať domáci aj medzinárodní darcovia, uvádza sa v správe. Na tejto správe sa podieľali Nasir Habib a Aliza Kassim z CNN.

article_content: A teenager convicted in the brutal gang rape and murder of a 23-year-old woman on a bus in Delhi has been sentenced to three years in jail, the maximum allowed under India's juvenile justice laws. This horrific crime sparked widespread public protests, leading to urgent calls for reforms in the country's sexual violence laws. The victim's family has passionately demanded a harsher punishment, arguing that the teenager should be tried as an adult due to the severity of the crime. Amid intense public outcry, the government promised swift justice and initiated reforms addressing sexual violence. The crime involved the victims being tricked onto an off-duty bus, where they endured a savage attack resulting in extensive internal injuries to the woman, which ultimately caused her death. Several other individuals involved in the crime are currently on trial, facing potential death penalty; one of the accused died in jail during the proceedings. A significant debate is ongoing concerning the appropriate age for criminal responsibility, with arguments focusing on considering an offender's mental and emotional maturity alongside chronological age. The teenager's personal history reveals that he left home at a young age and worked in various jobs before committing this crime.

Obete boli podvodom vlákané do autobusu, ktorý nebol v službe, kde boli brutálne napadnuté, čo spôsobilo žene rozsiahle vnútorné zranenia, ktoré viedli k jej smrti. article_content: A 70-year-old celebrated artist, Graham Ovenden, is facing accusations of child abuse, as revealed in court proceedings. The alleged incidents occurred during the 1970s and 80s, involving young girls who modeled for him. The victims were reportedly between six and fourteen years old at the time. The prosecution claims that Ovenden sexually abused the young girls. Allegedly, he blindfolded them and dressed them in Victorian-style nightgowns. These offenses supposedly took place at his residences in London and Cornwall between 1972 and 1985. Ramsay Quaife, the prosecutor, stated that the now-adult victims have provided similar accounts of the alleged abuse. Ovenden, known for his nude and semi-nude portraits of young girls, reportedly told police that he maintains a significant reputation for creating some of the finest child portraits in the past two centuries. Quaife informed Truro Crown Court in Cornwall that the incidents occurred while the children were modeling for Ovenden, who is also recognized as a respected fine art photographer. He characterized Ovenden as a 'paedophile' and 'sexual abuser of children,' alleging that young girls were his targets. The prosecutor described how Ovenden would dress the children in Victorian-era nightgowns before undressing and blindfolding them. Recounting one alleged victim's experience, Quaife mentioned that 'The defendant would put the tape down over her eyes… The tape was black, stretchy and smelt of glue.' Quaife added, 'Although she could not see, she could hear the defendant and she could remember the sound of his belt buckle.' He also alleged that Ovenden committed indecent assault against the children. According to the prosecution, the naked and blindfolded girls were positioned in ways that exposed their genitals for photographs. Ovenden, a Cornish artist from Pantersbridge, near Bodmin, has denied six charges of indecent assault and three charges of indecency with a child. The trial is ongoing. article_content: Research indicates that ice cream and lolly sales tend to climb once the temperature reaches 18 degrees Celsius. A study pinpointed this temperature as the trigger for increased demand for these frozen treats during warmer days. According to research, as soon as the temperature climbs to 18C, there's a noticeable surge in the sales of ice lollies, chocolate ice creams, and cornets. Jon Goldstone from Unilever noted that demand can significantly jump when summer temperatures rise even further. Unilever's scientists conducted the research that identified this trend. Goldstone explained that 18 degrees Celsius is a critical point, noting that consumer demand typically spikes once the temperature hits this mark. He added that after extended periods above 18 degrees Celsius, sales in the out-of-home market often increase tenfold. He added that ice cream sees a direct correlation between the temperature and consumption numbers during the summer, highlighting its seasonal appeal. The study, conducted by Unilever which owns brands like Wall's and Magnum, aimed to determine the specific temperature at which consumers actively seek out an ice cream treat. During July, over 3,200 tonnes of ice cream were produced weekly. The UK's largest ice cream factory, located in Gloucestershire, increased production shifts due to the summer's increased demand, producing 3,243 tonnes of ice cream weekly, at a rate of 0.45 tonnes per minute. The Magnum brand was produced at a rate of 1,125 per minute. Unilever noted that British ice cream consumption had previously lagged behind European levels; however, sales have increased by 1.5 per cent since June of the previous year. Frozen yogurt's popularity is increasing more quickly than ice cream's, with the UK market now valued at £13.2 million, marking a 33.9 per cent increase in the past year. Weather forecasts predict a return of warmer conditions, indicating a potentially hot start to September following recent cooler and wetter conditions. This warm spell may bring back the higher temperatures experienced in June and July.

article_content: New Zealand's new government has announced plans to repeal the nation's groundbreaking smoking ban to finance tax reductions. The legislation, initially introduced by the previous government led by Jacinda Ardern, intended to prohibit cigarette sales starting next year to individuals born after 2008. Given that smoking is the primary cause of preventable deaths in New Zealand, the policy aimed to prevent younger generations from developing the habit. Health specialists have voiced strong disapproval of this abrupt policy change. 'We are shocked and dismayed... this represents a significant step backward from world-leading, highly effective health measures,' stated Prof Richard Edwards, a tobacco control researcher and public health authority at the University of Otago. 'Most health organizations in New Zealand are deeply concerned about the government's actions and are urging them to reconsider,' he informed the BBC. The legislation, which was passed last year, had garnered international recognition, with research models supporting the pivotal reforms. These measures incorporated restricting the number of tobacco retailers and diminishing the nicotine content in cigarettes. Modelling suggested that the Smokefree laws could potentially save up to 5,000 lives annually. New Zealand's laws were thought to have influenced the UK government in September to declare a similar smoking ban for young individuals. A spokesperson affirmed that Prime Minister Rishi Sunak's stance remains unchanged following New Zealand's policy reversal. While lauded as a public health strategy, the Smokefree measures encountered resistance from certain business groups in New Zealand. Owners of newsagents and corner stores expressed concerns about revenue loss, even with government subsidies. Certain lawmakers, including the new Prime Minister Chris Luxon, also contended that a ban could foster a black market for tobacco. However, his National party, which secured 38% of the vote in the 14 October election, had not addressed the Smokefree laws during their campaign. The announcement by the new finance minister, Nicola Willis, on Saturday, that the government intended to repeal the laws, came as a surprise to health experts who had anticipated the policy would remain untouched. However, Ms. Willis stated that National's coalition partners—the populist New Zealand First and the libertarian Act party—had been 'insistent' on reversing the laws. Despite their election victory, the center-right National party experienced weeks of difficulty in policy negotiations to form a government with the two minor parties. An agreement was reached only on Friday, six weeks after the election, enabling the new government to be inaugurated on Monday. New Zealand First, which obtained 6% of the vote, was the only party that campaigned on repealing the smoking laws. Both minor parties blocked a key National policy aimed at opening up foreign property ownership, which the party had intended to use to fund tax cuts for middle and higher-income earners. Ms. Willis commented on Saturday that this situation prompted the party to explore alternative options. 'We must remember that the amendments to the Smokefree legislation had a considerable impact on the government's financial planning, accounting for approximately a billion dollars,' she stated to New Zealand broadcaster TV3's Newshub Nation. The laws still require formal repeal through parliament, where the government holds a majority. 'The idea that tax cuts would be financed by individuals who continue to smoke is utterly appalling,' stated Emeritus Prof Robert Beaglehole, chair of New Zealand's Action for Smokefree 2025 committee, to Pacific Media Network. A national Māori health organization, Hāpai Te Hauora, described it as an 'unconscionable blow to the health and well-being of all New Zealanders'. Smoking rates, along with related diseases and health issues, are highest among New Zealand's indigenous Māori population, for whom experts believed the policy would have had the most beneficial effect. 'The government is disregarding public opinion and clearly contradicting the vast majority of professionals, doctors, and nurses working in this field,' Prof Edwards stated. Public health modelling conducted in 2022 demonstrated that the Smokefree policy would have saved New Zealand's health system approximately NZ$1.3 billion (£630m; $790m) over the subsequent 20 years. New Zealand continues to aim to reduce its national smoking rate to 5% by 2025, with the long-term objective of eradicating it entirely. Over 80,000 adults have quit smoking in the past year, according to national data. Currently, about 8% of the adult population smokes. translated_content: Nová vláda Nového Zélandu oznámila plány zrušiť prelomový zákaz fajčenia v krajine, aby financovala zníženie daní. Legislatíva, ktorú zaviedla predchádzajúca vláda pod vedením Jacindy Ardernovej, mala zakázať predaj cigariet od budúceho roka osobám narodeným po roku 2008. Keďže fajčenie je hlavnou príčinou úmrtí, ktorým sa dá predísť na Novom Zélande, cieľom tejto politiky bolo zabrániť mladším generáciám začať fajčiť. Zdravotnícki odborníci vyjadrili silný nesúhlas s touto náhlou zmenou politiky. 'Sme šokovaní a zdesení... je to obrovský krok späť od popredných a vysoko účinných zdravotných opatrení,' uviedol profesor Richard Edwards, výskumník v oblasti kontroly tabaku a odborník na verejné zdravie z univerzity Otago. 'Väčšina zdravotníckych organizácií na Novom Zélande je hlboko znepokojená krokmi vlády a vyzýva ju, aby ich prehodnotila,' povedal pre BBC. Legislatíva, ktorá bola schválená minulý rok, získala medzinárodné uznanie a výskumné modely podporili jej kľúčové reformy. Tieto opatrenia zahŕňali obmedzenie počtu predajcov tabaku a zníženie obsahu nikotínu v cigaretách. Modelovanie naznačilo, že zákony Smokefree by mohli ročne zachrániť až 5 000 životov. Predpokladalo sa, že novozélandské zákony inšpirovali vládu Spojeného kráľovstva, ktorá v septembri oznámila podobný zákaz fajčenia pre mladých ľudí. Hovorca potvrdil, že postoj premiéra Rishiho Sunaka zostáva po zvrátení politiky Nového Zélandu nezmenený. Hoci boli opatrenia Smokefree oslavované ako stratégia verejného zdravia, stretli sa s odporom niektorých podnikateľských skupín na Novom Zélande. Majitelia novinových stánkov a malých obchodov vyjadrili obavy zo straty príjmov, a to aj napriek vládnym dotáciám. Niektorí zákonodarcovia, vrátane nového premiéra Chrisa Luxona, tiež tvrdili, že zákaz by mohol viesť k čiernemu trhu s tabakom. Jeho Národná strana, ktorá získala 38 % hlasov v októbrových voľbách, sa však počas kampane zákonom Smokefree nevenovala. Oznámenie novej ministerky financií Nicoly Willisovej v sobotu, že vláda plánuje zrušiť zákony, prekvapilo odborníkov na zdravie, ktorí očakávali, že politika zostane nedotknutá. Willisová však uviedla, že koaliční partneri Národnej strany – populistická strana Nový Zéland na prvom mieste a liberálna strana Act – trvali na zrušení zákonov. Napriek volebnému víťazstvu mala stredopravá Národná strana týždne ťažkostí pri rokovaniach o politike s cieľom vytvoriť vládu s dvoma menšími stranami. Dohodu dosiahli až v piatok, šesť týždňov po voľbách, čo umožnilo novej vláde zložiť prísahu v pondelok. Nový Zéland na prvom mieste, ktorý získal 6 % hlasov, bol jedinou stranou, ktorá viedla kampaň za zrušenie zákonov o fajčení. Obe menšie strany zablokovali kľúčovú politiku Národnej strany zameranú na otvorenie zahraničného vlastníctva nehnuteľností, ktoré strana zamýšľala využiť na financovanie zníženia daní pre stredné a vyššie príjmové skupiny. Willisová v sobotu poznamenala, že táto situácia podnietila stranu hľadať alternatívne riešenia. 'Musíme si uvedomiť, že zmeny v legislatíve Smokefree mali značný vplyv na štátny rozpočet, išlo približne o miliardu dolárov,' povedala pre novozélandskú televíziu TV3 Newshub Nation. Zákony si stále vyžadujú formálne zrušenie v parlamente, kde má vláda väčšinu. 'Myšlienka, že zníženie daní sa bude financovať z peňazí ľudí, ktorí naďalej fajčia, je absolútne šokujúca,' povedal emeritný profesor Robert Beaglehole, predseda novozélandskej organizácie Action for Smokefree 2025, pre Pacific Media Network. Národná organizácia pre zdravie Māori, Hāpai Te Hauora, to označila za 'nehoráznu ranu pre zdravie a blaho všetkých Novozélanďanov'. Miera fajčenia, spolu so súvisiacimi chorobami a zdravotnými problémami, je najvyššia medzi pôvodným obyvateľstvom Māori na Novom Zélande, pre ktorých by mala táto politika najväčší prínos. 'Vláda ignoruje verejnú mienku a zjavne odporuje prevažnej väčšine odborníkov, lekárov a sestier pracujúcich v tejto oblasti,' povedal profesor Edwards. Modelovanie verejného zdravia z roku 2022 ukázalo, že politika Smokefree by novozélandskému zdravotníckemu systému ušetrila približne 1,3 miliardy NZD (630 miliónov GBP; 790 miliónov USD) počas nasledujúcich 20 rokov. Nový Zéland sa aj naďalej snaží znížiť národnú mieru fajčenia na 5 % do roku 2025 s cieľom úplne ho odstrániť. Podľa národných údajov prestalo za posledný rok fajčiť viac ako 80 000 dospelých. V súčasnosti fajčí približne 8 % dospelej populácie. Čo si myslíte o plánoch Nového Zélandu týkajúcich sa zákazu fajčenia? Podeľte sa o svoje názory prostredníctvom e-mailu haveyoursay@bbc.co.uk. article_content: By Mike Larkin PUBLISHED: 20:18 EST, May 21, 2012 | UPDATED: 21:46 EST, May 21, 2012 Following the death of her mother, Whitney Houston, there have been concerns that Bobbi Kristina Brown could be struggling. Now, Bobbi Kristina Brown has been filmed gambling illegally in Las Vegas, just one day before her emotional appearance at the Billboard Awards. The 19-year-old was seen playing slot machines while accompanied by her 22-year-old boyfriend, Nick Gordon. Playing the slots: Bobbi Kristina Brown was filmed gambling in Las Vegas on Saturday night. It is illegal for anyone under 21 to gamble in Las Vegas. Underage individuals are also prohibited from loitering on casino floors. Unfortunately for Bobbi Kristina, an observant casino patron recorded her gambling at the MGM Resort and Casino. The footage was later leaked to TMZ. It is not clear whether she won any money. Casinos typically require identification before awarding large prizes. Breaking the law: Most casinos do not allow underage people to be present in the gaming area. David Salas, Deputy Chief of the Nevada Gaming Commission and State Gaming Control Board, told RumorFix, 'We will look into it.' He added that the video alone is insufficient evidence and investigators need more information before pressing charges. The MGM Grand is also conducting an internal investigation into the footage. In Nevada, underage gambling is a misdemeanor punishable by up to six months in county jail or a $1,000 fine. The casino could face a more significant financial penalty. Representatives from the Houston family have not yet commented. She was in Las Vegas to attend the music award ceremony on Sunday, where she accepted the Millennium Award on her mother's behalf in what was the show's most emotional moment. Highlight: Bobbi Kristina was joined by her aunt Pat Houston when she accepted the Millennium Award. Big moment: The show included a tribute to Whitney Houston, who died tragically following a cocaine overdose.

article_content: By Jessica Jerreat and Associated Press Reporter Former Boston Red Sox pitcher Curt Schilling has announced that his cancer, which he has been treated for since February, is in remission. The three-time World Series champion updated his fans via social media on Wednesday, thanking the Boston medical team that treated him. Schilling has not disclosed the specific type of cancer he was diagnosed with, but he maintained from the beginning that he would not let the disease defeat him. Winning: World Series champion Curt Schilling, pictured at a Red Sox game in May with his son Garrett, has announced his cancer is in remission. Relief: A tweet posted by Schilling on Wednesday announced that the baseball star was in remission. The 47-year-old, who worked as an analyst for ESPN after retiring from baseball, has shared regular updates on his cancer treatment in recent months. His remission announcement post was retweeted 2,500 times and favorited by over 5,000 followers. In April, his daughter Gabby shared a photo on Twitter of Schilling receiving his last chemotherapy session. 'Beyond blessed to be able to say that my dad finished his LAST chemo today! just 3 more days of radiation,' she tweeted. Schilling informed fans in February that he had cancer and planned to 'embrace this fight, just like the rest of them, with resolute faith, and head on'. In a statement released by ESPN on his behalf at the time, Schilling said: 'With my incredibly talented medical team, I'm ready to try and win another big game.' Fighter: Regular updates on Schilling's treatment were shared on Twitter, including the post above, when he had his last chemotherapy session. Champion: Schilling pitches at a Red Sox game in 2007. The three-time World Series star has been battling cancer since February. On May 28, Schilling received a loud ovation from Fenway Park fans during a pre-game ceremony honoring members of the 2004 team that won the Red Sox's first championship in 86 years. Like the other players, he walked in from the left-field wall, accompanied by his son Gehrig. The baseball champion, who now coaches his daughter's team, has won the World Series three times: once in 2001 with the Arizona Diamondbacks and twice with the Red Sox in 2004 and 2007. After pitching in the 2007 World Series, Schilling faced setbacks both on and off the field. His 2-1 victory in Game 2 of Boston's four-game sweep of the Colorado Rockies was his final game. Family man: Schilling, pictured with his wife Shonda in 2011, retired from baseball in 2009. He spent the entire 2008 season on the disabled list following right shoulder surgery and retired in March 2009. He started an unsuccessful video game company, 38 Studios, and later stated he invested and lost as much as $50 million. The company's collapse is the subject of a lawsuit in Rhode Island after it received a $75 million state-guaranteed loan.

Jeho víťazstvo 2:1 v zápase č. 2 bostonského štvordielneho víťazstva nad Colorado Rockies bolo jeho posledným zápasom. Rodinný muž: Schilling, vyobrazený so svojou manželkou Shondou v roku 2011, ukončil kariéru v bejzbale v roku 2009. Celú sezónu 2008 strávil na listine zranených po operácii pravého ramena a ukončil kariéru v marci 2009. Založil neúspešnú spoločnosť na výrobu videohier, 38 Studios, a neskôr uviedol, že investoval a stratil až 50 miliónov dolárov. Kolaps spoločnosti je predmetom súdneho sporu v Rhode Islande po tom, čo dostala štátom garantovanú pôžičku vo výške 75 miliónov dolárov.

article_content: Phil Neville has declined an opportunity to work under Louis van Gaal at Manchester United, opting instead to join the Match of the Day team as a television pundit next season. After being announced as a new member of the MOTD team for its 50th anniversary season, Neville informed his one million Twitter followers that he was no longer a coach at Manchester United, where he served as David Moyes’ first-team coach last season. He confirmed this by replying 'No' to the question: 'Phil, are you still on the coaching team at United?' Neville's introduction to television work occurred during the World Cup in Brazil this summer. The former defender has announced his departure from his coaching role at Manchester United. Manchester United later stated that Neville’s departure was his decision and that the club had been eager to offer him a role, alongside other 'Class of 92' figures like Ryan Giggs and Nicky Butt. The club intends to discuss potential ways for Neville to remain connected with United, possibly in an ambassadorial or community capacity. A spokesman stated: 'We remain of the view that we wanted him involved and didn’t think his television work would get in the way, as it hasn’t done for his brother, Gary.' However, Neville, 37, who faced considerable criticism for his commentary during England’s World Cup match against Italy, decided to focus entirely on his broadcasting career. His position under Van Gaal was expected to be less senior and influential compared to his role under Moyes. Neville confirmed his departure from the coaching staff at Old Trafford via Twitter. Neville played nearly 400 games in 11 years at United before signing for Everton in 2005 and returned to Old Trafford as a coach last year. With Van Gaal being assisted by Giggs and Butt, as well as backroom staff from Holland, Neville has chosen to commit fully to the BBC, a rival to Sky Sports, where his brother Gary Neville has become a prominent broadcaster. Match of the Day will have a refreshed lineup this season following Alan Hansen's retirement. Besides Neville, Gary Lineker will be joined by newcomers Ruud Gullit and Rio Ferdinand, along with Alan Shearer, Robbie Savage, and Danny Murphy. Neville’s decision to leave United was likely influenced, in part, by the negative feedback he received for his work with the BBC in Brazil. The former Everton and United player will be working alongside figures like Shearer and Ferdinand. The BBC received more than 400 complaints regarding Neville’s staccato and monotone delivery, leading the ex-player to admit it has been 'harder' than he expected, even joking that he was glad he could 'help the nation sleep'. Nevertheless, the BBC has decided to leverage his insight and knowledge of the game in a different format. This news is likely disappointing for United, who are keen to have many former players on their staff. Executive vice-chairman Ed Woodward stated during the club’s recent pre-season tour of America that he hoped Neville and Paul Scholes would play a role in Van Gaal’s team.

Po ohlásení ako nový člen tímu MOTD pre jeho 50. výročnú sezónu, Neville informoval svojich milión sledovateľov na Twitteri, že už nie je trénerom v Manchestri United, kde pôsobil ako tréner prvého tímu pod vedením Davida Moyesa v minulej sezóne. Potvrdil to odpoveďou 'Nie' na otázku: 'Phil, si stále v trénerskom tíme United?' Neville sa prvýkrát predstavil v úlohe televízneho komentátora počas Majstrovstiev sveta vo futbale v Brazílii toto leto. Bývalý obranca ohlásil svoj odchod z pozície trénera v Manchestri United. Manchester United neskôr uviedol, že Nevilleho odchod bol jeho rozhodnutím a že klub mu mal záujem ponúknuť rolu, spolu s ďalšími osobnosťami z 'Class of 92' ako Ryan Giggs a Nicky Butt. Klub má v úmysle prediskutovať potenciálne spôsoby, ako by Neville mohol zostať prepojený s United, prípadne v pozícii ambasádora alebo v rámci komunitných aktivít. Hovorca uviedol: 'Naďalej si myslíme, že sme chceli, aby sa zapojil, a nemysleli sme si, že by mu jeho práca v televízii prekážala, tak ako neprekáža jeho bratovi, Garymu.' Neville (37), ktorý čelil značnej kritike za svoj komentár počas zápasu Anglicka proti Taliansku na Majstrovstvách sveta, sa však rozhodol plne sústrediť na svoju kariéru v médiách. Očakávalo sa, že jeho pozícia pod vedením Van Gaala by bola menej významná a vplyvná v porovnaní s jeho rolou pod vedením Moyesa. Neville potvrdil svoj odchod z trénerského tímu na Old Trafford prostredníctvom Twitteru. Neville odohral takmer 400 zápasov počas 11 rokov v United predtým, ako v roku 2005 prestúpil do Evertonu, a minulý rok sa vrátil na Old Trafford ako tréner. Keďže Van Gaalovi asistujú Giggs a Butt, ako aj realizačný tím z Holandska, Neville sa rozhodol naplno sa venovať BBC, konkurentovi Sky Sports, kde sa jeho brat Gary Neville stal známou osobnosťou. Match of the Day bude mať v tejto sezóne osvieženú zostavu po odchode Alana Hansena do dôchodku. Okrem Nevilla sa ku Garymu Linekerovi pripoja noví experti Ruud Gullit a Rio Ferdinand, spolu s Alanom Shearerom, Robbiem Savageom a Dannym Murphym. Nevilleho rozhodnutie odísť z United bolo pravdepodobne čiastočne ovplyvnené negatívnou spätnou väzbou, ktorú dostal za svoju prácu pre BBC v Brazílii. Bývalý hráč Evertonu a United bude spolupracovať s osobnosťami ako Shearer a Ferdinand. BBC dostala viac ako 400 sťažností týkajúcich sa Nevilleho trhaného a monotónneho prejavu, čo viedlo bývalého hráča k priznaniu, že to bolo 'ťažšie', ako očakával, a dokonca žartoval, že bol rád, že mohol 'pomôcť národu zaspať'. Napriek tomu sa BBC rozhodla využiť jeho postrehy a znalosti o hre v inej podobe. Je pravdepodobné, že táto správa sklamala United, ktorí chcú mať vo svojom tíme čo najviac bývalých hráčov. Výkonný viceprezident Ed Woodward počas nedávnej predsezónnej túry klubu po Amerike uviedol, že dúfa, že Neville a Paul Scholes budú hrať určitú rolu v tíme Van Gaala.

article_content: Reports suggest that at least three prominent Conservative donors were recruited by Prime Minister David Cameron to shape Government policy. A fourth donor allegedly gained financially from the Libyan conflict. These revelations have sparked worries that affluent business figures are receiving special access to key government operations after donating substantial sums to the Conservative Party. Stanley Fink, the newly reappointed treasurer, swiftly issued a letter to donors. It stated that ministers must now seek approval before implementing policy ideas suggested by donors. Fink wrote that if a minister's interaction with a donor leads to a policy suggestion, the minister must inform their private office, which will then seek guidance from the Permanent Secretary. JCB head Sir Anthony Bamford, a significant Tory donor (over £1.8 million since Cameron's leadership), was hosted at a 'Thank you dinner' by Cameron and party co-chairman Andrew Feldman shortly after the 2010 election. Later, Bamford was commissioned to write a Government report on manufacturing's future. Another dinner occurred in the Camerons' private residence above 11 Downing Street last November. The guest was Ian Taylor, a major oil trader and donor of £466,000 to the Tories. Venture capitalist Adrian Beecroft, who donated £593,000 to the Tories since 2005, was asked to advise on employment rights policy. His company, Vitol, had supplied oil to Libyan rebels in a deal exceeding £100 million, facilitated by a Foreign Office oil cell set up by Alan Duncan, who previously consulted for Vitol. Lord Ashcroft, Cameron's largest donor (£4.3 million), was entertained at Chequers in June 2010. A year later, he led a review of the Ministry of Defence’s overseas bases. Beecroft's proposals, advocating easier dismissal of employees, were backed by Steve Hilton but suppressed after disagreements with the Liberal Democrats. Bamford's report seemingly had more impact. He urged the Government to prioritize manufacturing and reduce business taxes to boost engineering. The Chancellor subsequently emphasized Corporation Tax cuts in the Budget. Michael Spencer, a former Tory treasurer, reportedly knew in advance about the Government's veto of French financial transaction tax plans. He attributed this knowledge to close relationships with senior administration members. Details of these donor activities imply that close ties between party supporters and politicians can lead to policy influence or insider knowledge. Peter Cruddas claimed a donor wrote a paper on gay marriage for the No. 10 policy unit, influencing party policy. Cameron's spokesman denied any such paper existed. Lord Fink was brought back as treasurer due to his perceived reliability, especially after the Cruddas scandal. He is considered discreet and well-regarded by other donors. Fink's background includes transforming Man Group into a leading hedge fund. Despite a brain tumor diagnosis, he returned to the City with International Standard Asset Management. He is from a modest background, attended Manchester Grammar School, and met his wife through volunteer work. He supports the Conservative cause due to a negative experience with trade unions as a student. He enjoys the benefits of his success, including a chauffeur, a house, and a ski chalet. He likes to share his wealth with friends. The recent funding scandal may require Fink to utilize his wealth further for the Conservative Party.

Tieto odhalenia vyvolali obavy, že bohatí podnikatelia získavajú špeciálny prístup ku kľúčovým vládnym operáciám po tom, čo venovali značné sumy Konzervatívnej strane. Zdá sa, že Bamfordova správa mala väčší vplyv. Apeloval na vládu, aby uprednostnila výrobu a znížila dane z podnikania s cieľom podporiť inžinierstvo. Následne kancelár zdôraznil zníženie dane z príjmu právnických osôb v rozpočte. Michael Spencer, bývalý pokladník Konzervatívnej strany, údajne vopred vedel o vládnom vete voči plánom Francúzska na daň z finančných transakcií. Túto znalosť pripisoval úzkym vzťahom s vysokopostavenými členmi administratívy. Podrobnosti o týchto aktivitách darcov naznačujú, že úzke väzby medzi podporovateľmi strany a politikmi môžu viesť k ovplyvňovaniu politiky alebo k interným informáciám. Peter Cruddas tvrdil, že jeden z darcov napísal dokument o manželstvách osôb rovnakého pohlavia pre politickú jednotku na Downing Street 10, a tak ovplyvnil politiku strany. Cameronov hovorca poprel, že by takýto dokument existoval. Lord Fink bol privedený späť ako pokladník kvôli jeho vnímanej spoľahlivosti, najmä po škandále Cruddas. Považuje sa za diskrétneho a medzi darcami je dobre hodnotený. Finkovo pozadie zahŕňa transformáciu Man Group na popredný hedžový fond. Napriek diagnóze nádoru na mozgu sa vrátil do finančnej štvrte City so spoločnosťou International Standard Asset Management. Pochádza zo skromných pomerov, navštevoval gymnázium v Manchestri a svoju manželku stretol prostredníctvom dobrovoľníckej práce. Konzervatívnu stranu podporuje kvôli negatívnej skúsenosti s odbormi počas štúdia. Užíva si výhody svojho úspechu, vrátane šoféra, domu a lyžiarskej chaty. Rád sa delí o svoje bohatstvo s priateľmi. Nedávny škandál s financovaním môže vyžadovať, aby Fink ešte viac využil svoje bohatstvo pre Konzervatívnu stranu.

article_content: Pedro Quezada, the recent $338 million Powerball winner, is expected in a New Jersey court this Monday due to an outstanding child support warrant. According to William Maer of the Passaic County Sheriff's Office, Quezada, aged 44 and a father of five children aged 5 to 23, reportedly owes $29,000 in unpaid child support. The warrant, issued back in 2009, was put on hold pending Quezada's court appearance. His son, Casiano, mentioned on Thursday that his father has engaged legal counsel and is addressing the matter. Efforts to contact Quezada's lawyer were unsuccessful. Maer noted that such warrants typically lead to payment, a payment plan, or arrest. Maer refrained from further comment due to the ongoing investigation. Judith Drucker from the New Jersey Lottery stated that lottery winners exceeding $600 are checked for debts like taxes and child support. These outstanding amounts are deducted from the lottery payout. Quezada opted for a lump-sum payment, which will be around $152 million post-taxes. Lorenzo Ferrigno contributed to this report.

Podľa Williama Maera z úradu šerifa okresu Passaic, Quezada, vo veku 44 rokov a otec piatich detí vo veku 5 až 23 rokov, údajne dlhuje 29 000 dolárov na nezaplatenom výživnom. Zatykač, vydaný ešte v roku 2009, bol pozastavený do Quezadovho vystúpenia na súde. Jeho syn, Casiano, sa vo štvrtok zmienil, že jeho otec si najal právneho zástupcu a rieši túto záležitosť. Quezada sa rozhodol pre jednorazovú platbu, ktorá bude po zdanení predstavovať približne 152 miliónov dolárov. Lorenzo Ferrigno prispel k tejto správe.

article_content: Dutch Prime Minister Mark Rutte resigned on Monday after a far-right party rescinded its support for his government, according to a government spokesman. This action may lead to early elections in the Netherlands, potentially as soon as this summer, the government stated. The resignation occurred after the far-right party withdrew from discussions regarding a €14.2 billion austerity package, equivalent to $18.6 billion, as reported on a parliamentary website. Lawmakers are scheduled to convene on Tuesday to determine the next steps. Then Queen Beatrix, requested that Rutte and his ministers remain in their positions until new elections were held. Rutte's government depended on the support of Geert Wilders' Party for Freedom, which secured third place in parliamentary elections in 2010. In 2010, no party obtained enough seats to govern independently, leading Rutte to form a coalition with another center-right party. However, even this alliance lacked a majority in parliament, necessitating support from Wilders' anti-Muslim party. The Party for Freedom did not gain control of any government ministries, but the coalition agreement incorporated elements it advocated for, such as a ban on burqas. This ban has not been implemented. Wilders' Party for Freedom surpassed expectations by winning 24 parliamentary seats in June 2010, more than doubling its previous seat count. Wilders has faced legal challenges for years, accused of inciting hatred against Muslims with his controversial film 'Fitna.' The film, released online in March 2008, sparked international criticism and featured disturbing images of terrorist acts superimposed over Quranic verses, seemingly attempting to portray Islam as a threat to Western society.

article_content: Jenson Button seems secure in his position at McLaren, as the team approaches the announcement of its driver lineup for the upcoming season. Despite his recent retirement from the Singapore Grand Prix on Sunday, marking his first failure to complete a race in two years, the 34-year-old driver expressed no concerns about his prospects for 2015. In a statement to Press Association Sport, Button conveyed his peace of mind: 'I'm not at all worried about that. I'm quite confident I'll be here next year, and I believe I'm performing well currently.' While Jenson Button's future has been a frequent topic of speculation, the British driver is assured he will remain with McLaren in 2015. Button's retirement at the Singapore Grand Prix was his first DNF (Did Not Finish) in two seasons. He added, 'I simply need to improve my Saturdays during qualifying. I've had some misfortune and haven't consistently maximized my performance each weekend, which is frustrating, but I'll resolve it.' Racing director Eric Boullier revealed that discussions between himself and McLaren Group chairman and CEO Ron Dennis are progressing quickly. Earlier in the month, Dennis had indicated that a final decision would be revealed in Abu Dhabi at the season's end, approximately eight weeks from then. 'We are making headway daily, although there are absolutely no immediate plans to make any announcements,' Boullier stated. Boullier further explained, 'The decision rests with Ron and myself, but Ron, as the owner and chairman, has the final say. However, protocol dictates that the board makes the ultimate decision. Generally, Ron and I are in agreement. Regarding the driver selection, we maintain transparency and openness with each other. 'We have our perspectives and some preferences regarding the timing, but we are aligned on our expectations, our objectives, and our direction. Things are progressing smoothly.' Button hopes he has done enough to persuade McLaren chairman and CEO Ron Dennis of his worth for a 2015 drive. With Honda set to become the power-unit supplier next year, replacing Mercedes, Button anticipates potential challenges. 'I know Honda will be dedicated to being competitive from the start,' Button remarked. 'However, Formula One is incredibly competitive now, and Mercedes has excelled. 'It will always be challenging to compete with a team that already possesses experience with the engine. There will certainly be a learning phase.'
translated_content: Zdá sa, že Jenson Button je si istý svojou pozíciou v McLarene, keďže sa tím blíži k oznámeniu zostavy jazdcov pre nadchádzajúcu sezónu. Napriek jeho nedávnemu odstúpeniu z Veľkej ceny Singapuru v nedeľu, čo bolo jeho prvé nedokončenie pretekov za posledné dva roky, 34-ročný jazdec nevyjadril žiadne obavy ohľadom svojich vyhliadok na rok 2015. V rozhovore pre Press Association Sport Button vyjadril svoj pokoj: 'Vôbec sa toho nebojím. Som si celkom istý, že tu budem aj budúci rok a myslím si, že momentálne podávam dobrý výkon.' Hoci bola budúcnosť Jensona Buttona častou témou špekulácií, britský jazdec je si istý, že zostane v McLarene aj v roku 2015. Buttonovo odstúpenie na Veľkej cene Singapuru bolo jeho prvé DNF (Did Not Finish) za dve sezóny. Dodal: 'Jednoducho musím zlepšiť svoje soboty počas kvalifikácie. Mal som trochu smoly a nie vždy som maximalizoval svoj výkon každý víkend, čo je frustrujúce, ale vyriešim to.' Pretekársky riaditeľ Eric Boullier prezradil, že diskusie medzi ním a predsedom a generálnym riaditeľom skupiny McLaren, Ronom Dennisom, rýchlo napredujú. Začiatkom mesiaca Dennis naznačil, že konečné rozhodnutie bude oznámené v Abu Dhabi na konci sezóny, približne o osem týždňov. 'Denne robíme pokroky, hoci absolútne neexistujú žiadne bezprostredné plány na akékoľvek oznámenia,' uviedol Boullier. Boullier ďalej vysvetlil: 'Rozhodnutie je na mne a Ronovi, ale Ron, ako vlastník a predseda, má posledné slovo. Protokol však hovorí, že konečné rozhodnutie prijíma predstavenstvo. Vo všeobecnosti sa s Ronom zhodujeme. Pokiaľ ide o výber jazdcov, zachovávame voči sebe transparentnosť a otvorenosť. 'Máme svoje perspektívy a určité preferencie týkajúce sa načasovania, ale zhodujeme sa na našich očakávaniach, našich cieľoch a našom smerovaní. Veci napredujú hladko.' Button dúfa, že urobil dosť pre to, aby presvedčil predsedu a generálneho riaditeľa McLarenu, Rona Dennisa, o svojej hodnote pre jazdu v roku 2015. S Hondou, ktorá sa má stať dodávateľom pohonných jednotiek budúci rok a nahradiť Mercedes, Button predvída potenciálne výzvy. 'Viem, že Honda sa bude usilovať o to, aby bola konkurencieschopná od začiatku,' poznamenal Button. 'Formula 1 je však teraz neuveriteľne konkurencieschopná a Mercedes vynikal. 'Vždy bude náročné konkurovať tímu, ktorý už má skúsenosti s motorom. Určite bude existovať fáza učenia.'

article_content: During the final day of the G20 Summit, an Australian flag was burned at an Indigenous rally in Brisbane's CBD. The second protest against Indigenous deaths in custody took place near the Roma St Forum, where rows of police, including members of the riot squad, had gathered. Before being incinerated at Emma Miller Place, the flags were marked with skulls and words. Effigies of Indigenous leaders Noel Pearson, Marcia Langton, and Warren Mundine were also burned. Photos labeled 'Queen Marcia Langton,' 'King Noel Pearson,' and 'King Warren Mundine' were attached to stakes holding their effigies. Queensland Premier Campbell Newman expressed his disapproval of the flag burning, stating to Nine News that while he respects the right to protest, he does not condone such actions. Approximately 50 protesters chanted 'resist, revise, decolonise' before a crowd of around 300 people. The group of roughly 50 protesters is angered by Prime Minister Tony Abbott's comments about Australia's history. Activist Wayne Wharton stated, 'He refers to this country as desolate (prior to the arrival of the first fleet). He welcomes the world leaders and tells them there was nothing. So we have to resort to symbolism to show our disgust in your colonial leadership.' Mr. Wharton added that Australia was founded in bloodshed and ruled by force. He criticized the heavy police presence and their carrying of firearms, stating, 'It's no different to how you showed up in 1770.' As speeches continued, protesters circled a pile of shredded paper before parading six flags before the crowd. Police officers did not intervene. The group then burned effigies of Warren Mundine, Noel Pearson, and Marcia Langton to chants of 'sell outs!' Brisbane is experiencing a heatwave on the last day of the G20 summit, with temperatures expected to reach 40C. On Friday, approximately 500 people marched through the CBD, chanting 'they say murder, we say justice.'

article_content: In recent Swiss parliamentary elections, the far-right Swiss People's Party (SVP) experienced setbacks, despite their history of using xenophobic and anti-immigration campaign strategies. Voters favored more moderate parties over divisive candidates, marking a shift from the SVP's peak performance four years prior. The Conservative Democrats and Liberal Greens emerged as clear winners, suggesting a change in Switzerland's politically polarized environment. According to Swissinfo.ch, the national public broadcaster, the SVP's support significantly decreased, although they still maintain a lead over the center-left Social Democrats. The traditional center-right parties, the Radicals and Christian Democrats, also saw declines of 3% and 1.5% respectively, as reported by Swissinfo.ch. The SVP's loss was unexpected, given the widespread belief that their fear-mongering tactics would succeed again. Their campaigns included controversial posters: one in the German-speaking region depicting black boots marching over the Swiss flag, and another in French-speaking areas showing a condom on the European Union flag, with the slogan 'Swiss protection against the European virus.' The anti-immigrant party aimed to replicate their 2007 victory, with pre-election polls initially indicating their dominance. However, despite a Eurobarometer survey showing the SVP ahead with nearly a third of the projected vote, the election results told a different story. The Social Democrats held second place with around 20% in pre-election polls, followed by the FDP Liberals, Christian Democrats, and the Greens. The SVP achieved its largest victory in 2007 by blaming foreigners for the country's crime, capitalizing on anti-immigration sentiments to secure 29% of the vote. This was roughly consistent with their pre-election poll numbers. Switzerland's consensus-driven political system mitigates the impact of radical policies, regardless of election outcomes. However, anti-immigrant sentiments contributed to the 2009 ban on minaret construction, following an SVP campaign highlighting the perceived political symbolism of minarets, which they argued violated the constitution. The SVP's campaign against minarets featured fliers showing a veiled woman against a Swiss flag background, pierced by missile-like minarets. The Federal Commission against Racism condemned these posters for defaming peaceful Swiss Muslims, promoting prejudice, and portraying the Muslim community as desiring dominance, female oppression, and the trampling of fundamental rights. Four years prior, the SVP used a poster featuring a white sheep kicking a black sheep off the Swiss flag. They also advocated for the deportation of immigrant families if their children committed crimes. Despite the SVP's significant win in 2007, voters also elected Ricardo Lumengo, the first black politician to the National Council. Lumengo, who sought asylum from Angola, accused the SVP of 'scapegoating.'

Voliči uprednostnili umiernenejšie strany pred rozdeľujúcimi kandidátmi, čo značí posun od vrcholného výkonu SVP spred štyroch rokov. Konzervatívni demokrati a Liberálni zelení sa ukázali ako jasní víťazi, čo naznačuje zmenu v politicky polarizovanom prostredí Švajčiarska. Podľa Swissinfo.ch, národného verejnoprávneho vysielateľa, podpora SVP výrazne klesla, hoci si stále udržuje náskok pred stredoľavicovými sociálnymi demokratmi. Tradičné stredopravicové strany, Radikáli a Kresťanskí demokrati, tiež zaznamenali pokles o 3%, respektíve o 1,5%, ako uvádza Swissinfo.ch. Strata SVP bola neočakávaná vzhľadom na rozšírené presvedčenie, že ich taktika šírenia strachu opäť uspeje. Ich kampane zahŕňali kontroverzné plagáty: jeden v nemecky hovoriacom regióne zobrazoval čierne topánky pochodujúce po švajčiarskej vlajke a ďalší vo francúzsky hovoriacich oblastiach zobrazoval kondóm na vlajke Európskej únie s heslom 'Švajčiarska ochrana proti európskemu vírusu.' Protiimigračná strana sa snažila zopakovať svoje víťazstvo z roku 2007, pričom predvolebné prieskumy spočiatku naznačovali ich dominanciu. Avšak napriek prieskumu Eurobarometra, ktorý ukázal SVP vpredu s takmer tretinou predpokladaných hlasov, výsledky volieb hovorili iný príbeh. Sociálni demokrati obsadili druhé miesto s približne 20% v predvolebných prieskumoch, nasledovaní FDP Liberálmi, Kresťanskými demokratmi a Zelenými. SVP dosiahla svoje najväčšie víťazstvo v roku 2007 tým, že obviňovala cudzincov zo zločinnosti v krajine, pričom využila protimigračné nálady na zabezpečenie 29% hlasov. To bolo približne v súlade s ich predvolebnými číslami. Systém politiky Švajčiarska založený na konsenze zmierňuje dopad radikálnych politík bez ohľadu na výsledky volieb. Protimigračné nálady však prispeli k zákazu výstavby minaretov v roku 2009, ktorý nasledoval po kampani SVP zdôrazňujúcej vnímanú politickú symboliku minaretov, ktoré podľa nich porušovali ústavu. Kampaň SVP proti minaretom obsahovala letáky zobrazujúce zahalenú ženu na pozadí švajčiarskej vlajky, prepichnutú minaretmi podobnými raketám. Federálna komisia proti rasizmu odsúdila tieto plagáty za hanobenie mierumilovných švajčiarskych moslimov, podporu predsudkov a zobrazovanie moslimskej komunity ako túžiacej po dominancii, útlaku žien a pošliapavaní základných práv. Štyri roky predtým SVP použila plagát zobrazujúci bielu ovcu kopajúcu čiernu ovcu zo švajčiarskej vlajky. Tiež obhajovali deportáciu prisťahovaleckých rodín, ak ich deti spáchali zločiny. Napriek významnému víťazstvu SVP v roku 2007 voliči tiež zvolili Ricarda Lumenga, prvého černošského politika do Národnej rady. Lumengo, ktorý hľadal azyl z Angoly, obvinil SVP z 'hľadania obetných baránkov.'

article_content: LOS ANGELES, California (CNN) -- Brandon Boyd blends into his Venice, California, neighborhood like any other resident. Brandon Boyd, the frontman for Incubus, is going on tour with the band in July. He surfs and prefers a local smoothie shop over Starbucks. He walks his French bulldog, Bruce. Oh, and he also paints and makes music with his multiplatinum rock band, Incubus. The quintet embarks on a North American summer tour in July and recently released a greatest hits collection titled 'Monuments and Melodies.' The album packaging features artwork by Boyd, who held his first solo art exhibit at Mr. Musichead Rock Art Gallery in Los Angeles last fall. The gallery is located on the Sunset Strip, not far from the clubs where Incubus played their initial shows. His most striking paintings are large, fantasy-inspired pieces rendered in rich burgundy or aqua hues. Typically, Boyd creates his artwork in a corner of his kitchen, where an easel is always set up. It's a zen-like space with high ceilings, polished concrete floors, and warm, burnished wood. Instead of a Buddha statue, he uses a rubber rabbit's head for inspiration. Boyd jokes that his home was a brothel in the 1900s. CNN spoke with Boyd about collaboration, the fulfillment he finds in art, and his pursuit of the perfect wave. The following is an edited version of the interview. CNN: Isn't it ironic that you had your first solo art show before releasing your first solo album? Brandon Boyd: I hadn't given much thought to solo work until recently. Mainly because Incubus is a very collaborative band. I contribute my part, and everyone else does too, but ultimately, we operate democratically. We compromise on many songs, which is why we sound the way we do -- it's the result of five minds meeting in the middle. My art, on the other hand, is completely self-indulgent. CNN: What does art fulfill in you that music doesn't? Boyd: To me, it's like the difference between a pen and a paintbrush. Music and art come from the same intangible place -- it's like drawing from the ether. I don't know where it comes from; nobody really does. It arrives when it wants to. I've been painting, drawing, and taking pictures for as long as I've been writing music -- and actually drawing longer. I didn't seek it out; it found me. CNN: Your parents always encouraged you to explore your artistic side. Boyd: My parents are wonderful, and I'm very lucky. My mom has always been predominantly right-brained, relying heavily on her feelings and intuition. She instilled that in my brothers and me, along with the importance of visualization as a tool for manifesting things in your life. From a young age, if I didn't feel well, she would say, 'Draw what's happening and draw a solution.' If I had a stomach ache, I would draw a picture of my stomach and what I imagined the bad germs looked like -- they had little robber masks on. Then I would draw a good germ, with a cape, tights, and a washcloth, flying around cleaning up the bad germs. For some reason, I always felt better afterward. CNN: Did you ever visualize and draw what you wanted to achieve in your music career? Boyd: Sometimes, yes. The guys in the band and I grew up together, and when they said, 'We want to play music, let's start a band. You should be the singer,' I agreed. I hadn't written anything or even really sung before, but they knew I could draw, so they thought I could write lyrics or carry a tune. I would visualize lines and melodies, then sound them out to them, and they would help me guide it through the instruments. Eventually, I became proficient enough to do it independently. CNN: When you finish a painting, is it similar to finishing a song or an album? Boyd: Yes, there's definitely a sense of accomplishment. It's rarely unclear when a painting or a song is finished. You just know. Someone wise once said, when asked how you know when you're done with a painting, 'How do you know when you're done making love?' I always thought that was a great analogy. CNN: Did you ever consider a fallback job, like being an accountant, lawyer, or working for IBM? Boyd: I feel very blessed, but no. I knew from a young age that this is what I was meant to do. I made very adult decisions as a teenager based on that knowledge. There was really no question about it. CNN: What else do you want to do? Boyd: Painting and art are my main focus, but I also dream of getting a really big tube at the Bonsai Pipeline soon.
translated_content: LOS ANGELES, Kalifornia (CNN) -- Brandon Boyd zapadá do svojej štvrti v Benátkach v Kalifornii ako každý iný obyvateľ. Brandon Boyd, frontman skupiny Incubus, ide v júli na turné s kapelou. Surfuje a uprednostňuje miestny smoothie shop pred Starbucks. Venčí svojho francúzskeho buldočka, Brucea. A tiež maľuje a tvorí hudbu so svojou multi-platinovou rockovou kapelou, Incubus. Kvinteto sa v júli vydáva na severoamerické letné turné a nedávno vydalo kolekciu najväčších hitov s názvom 'Monuments and Melodies'. Obal albumu obsahuje Boydove umelecké diela, ktorý minulú jeseň usporiadal svoju prvú samostatnú výstavu umenia v galérii Mr. Musichead Rock Art Gallery v Los Angeles. Galéria sa nachádza na Sunset Strip, neďaleko od klubov, kde Incubus odohrali svoje prvé vystúpenia. Jeho najvýraznejšie obrazy sú veľké, fantasy-inšpirované diela namaľované v bohatej bordovej alebo akvamarínovej farbe. Boyd zvyčajne tvorí svoje umelecké diela v rohu svojej kuchyne, kde má vždy postavený stojan. Je to zenový priestor s vysokými stropmi, leštenými betónovými podlahami a teplým, lešteným drevom. Namiesto sochy Budhu používa na inšpiráciu hlavu gumového zajaca. Boyd žartuje, že jeho dom bol v 19. storočí bordelom. CNN sa s Boydom rozprávala o spolupráci, naplnení, ktoré nachádza v umení, a o jeho snahe nájsť dokonalú vlnu. Nasleduje upravená verzia rozhovoru. CNN: Nie je ironické, že ste mali svoju prvú samostatnú výstavu umenia predtým, ako ste vydali svoj prvý sólový album? Brandon Boyd: Až donedávna som o sólovej tvorbe veľmi nerozmýšľal. Hlavne preto, že Incubus je veľmi spolupracujúca kapela. Prispievam svojou časťou a všetci ostatní tiež, ale v konečnom dôsledku fungujeme demokraticky. Pri mnohých piesňach robíme kompromisy, a preto znieme tak, ako znieme -- je to výsledok toho, že sa v strede stretne päť myslí. Moje umenie je, na druhej strane, úplne sebecké. CNN: Čo ti umenie napĺňa, čo ti hudba nedáva? Boyd: Pre mňa je to ako rozdiel medzi perom a štetcom. Hudba a umenie pochádzajú z toho istého nehmotného miesta -- je to ako čerpanie z éteru. Neviem, odkiaľ to pochádza; nikto vlastne nevie. Prichádza to, keď to chce. Maľujem, kreslím a fotografujem tak dlho, ako píšem hudbu -- a vlastne kreslím dlhšie. Nehľadal som to; ono si to našlo mňa. CNN: Vaši rodičia vás vždy povzbudzovali, aby ste skúmali svoju umeleckú stránku. Boyd: Moji rodičia sú úžasní a mám veľké šťastie. Moja mama bola vždy prevažne pravostranná, silne sa spoliehala na svoje pocity a intuíciu. Vštepovala to mne a mojim bratom, spolu s dôležitosťou vizualizácie ako nástroja na prejavovanie vecí vo vašom živote. Už od útleho veku, keď som sa necítil dobre, povedala mi: 'Nakresli, čo sa deje, a nakresli riešenie.' Keď ma bolelo brucho, nakreslil som si obrázok svojho žalúdka a to, ako som si predstavoval, že vyzerajú zlé baktérie -- mali malé masky lupičov. Potom som nakreslil dobrého bacila s plášťom, pančuchami a handrou, ktorý lietal a upratoval zlé bacily. Z nejakého dôvodu som sa potom vždy cítil lepšie. CNN: Vizualizoval si si a kreslil si niekedy to, čo si chcel dosiahnuť vo svojej hudobnej kariére? Boyd: Niekedy áno. Chlapci v kapele a ja sme spolu vyrastali, a keď povedali: 'Chceme hrať hudbu, založme kapelu. Ty by si mal byť spevák,' súhlasil som. Nikdy predtým som nič nenapísal ani som naozaj nespieval, ale vedeli, že viem kresliť, tak si mysleli, že by som mohol písať texty alebo zaspievať melódiu. Vizualizoval by som si linky a melódie, potom by som im ich zaspieval a oni by mi pomohli previesť ich cez nástroje. Nakoniec som sa stal natoľko zdatným, že som to dokázal robiť samostatne. CNN: Keď dokončíš obraz, je to podobné ako dokončenie piesne alebo albumu? Boyd: Áno, určite je to pocit úspechu. Zriedka je nejasné, kedy je obraz alebo pieseň dokončená. Proste to vieš. Raz múdry človek povedal, keď sa ho spýtali, ako vieš, kedy si s maľbou hotový: 'Ako vieš, kedy si skončil s milovaním?' Vždy som si myslel, že je to skvelá analógia. CNN: Uvažoval si niekedy o záložnej práci, ako byť účtovníkom, právnikom alebo pracovať pre IBM? Boyd: Cítim sa veľmi požehnaný, ale nie. Už od útleho veku som vedel, že toto je to, čo mám robiť. Ako teenager som na základe týchto vedomostí robil veľmi dospelé rozhodnutia. O tom nebolo naozaj pochýb. CNN: Čo ešte chceš robiť? Boyd: Maľovanie a umenie sú mojím hlavným zameraním, ale tiež snívam o tom, že sa mi čoskoro podarí dostať do naozaj veľkej vlny na Bonsai Pipeline.

article_content: Ellis Island is set to reopen to the public a year after Hurricane Sandy impacted it. The 27.5-acre island was without power for months after the hurricane flooded its boilers and electrical systems, threatening its rich history of American immigration. Although restoration work continues, the island off Manhattan will welcome visitors again on Monday. Ellis Island in New York City is reopening one year after being severely affected by Hurricane Sandy. The island's buildings were inundated with water from the hurricane, leaving it without power for several months. Over one million photographs and artifacts are being stored while the buildings are being restored. Hurricane Sandy caused a surge of water that swamped the island, causing months-long power outages. More than 12 million people passed through the Port of New York between 1892 and 1954, after the U.S. government opened the first Federal immigration station on the island in 1890. It's estimated that over half of the current U.S. population can trace their ancestry to someone who passed through its immigration checkpoints nearly 200 years ago. This isn't the first time the island's buildings have undergone restoration since its construction in 1890. The Ellis Island Immigration Museum houses over a million photographs and artifacts. It is estimated that more than 12 million people passed through the island's immigration checks between 1892 and 1954. With its rich immigration history, the island has become a popular tourist destination. On June 15, 1897, a fire destroyed the complex of wooden buildings on the island, which had been doubled in size to accommodate the influx of immigrants. Despite over 150 people being on the island, no one was killed in the fire. Subsequently, the government planned to rebuild the station with fireproof buildings, the first of which was erected in 1900. In 1902, a hospital was added to the complex, but it was overwhelmed by the number of immigrants needing treatment before entering the country. Immigrants wait in line to board a ferry to New York after passing through Ellis Island in 1900. Among the island's buildings are a kitchen and laundry facility, as well as a hospital and museum. The nearby Liberty Island was also affected by the hurricane last year but reopened in July. It was forced to close again during the government shutdown. Although the station remained open until 1954, stricter immigration laws introduced in 1920 significantly reduced the number of immigrants, effectively ending the country's 'open-door policy'. The nearby Liberty Island was also impacted by Hurricane Sandy. Home to the Statue of Liberty, the island reopened in July but closed again during the government shutdown.

article_content: Following a previous imprisonment for cannibalism, two brothers in Pakistan have been arrested once more after authorities discovered a child's severed head at their residence. The home is situated in a remote village in northwest Pakistan. Residents alerted the police due to an offensive odor emanating from the house of Mohammed Arif Ali, located in Kahawar Khan, a village within the Bhakkar district of Punjab. This prompted the investigation. Ameer Abdullah Khan, the district police chief, informed CNN that upon investigating, officers discovered the infant's decapitated head beside a burning stove. The head is estimated to be approximately five days old and is currently undergoing examination at a hospital in Darya Khan. Arif Ali was immediately taken into custody at the scene. His brother, Mohammed Farman Ali, was captured by police a few hours later just outside their village. Law enforcement officials reported that both men admitted to the consumption of human flesh. The brothers were released from prison the previous year after serving a two-year sentence for similar acts. They had admitted to dismembering a woman's body, which they had exhumed from a graveyard in Darya Khan, their place of residence at the time. Due to the absence of specific legislation addressing cannibalism in Pakistan, the brothers were convicted of defiling a deceased body and committing other offenses against public order. This case generated widespread outrage throughout Pakistan, according to CNN's affiliate Geo TV.
