article_content: UTTAR PRADESH, India (CNN) -- An Indian police officer grabs a suspect's hair with both hands, twists, and lifts her until her feet dangle above the ground. The suspect: a 6-year-old girl accused of stealing 280 rupees, approximately 6 dollars. The incident led to one officer being fired and another suspended. The charges against the girl were dropped. The event was captured on video in February of this year. Harcharand Singh and his wife shared their story. Mr. Singh says their son, accused of theft, died while in police custody. Two years prior, in another Indian state, a similar incident was caught on tape: a police officer watched as a crowd beat an accused thief. The officer then bound the suspect and dragged him behind a motorcycle, causing severe skin abrasions. The accused survived the beating. Two officers were fired in that incident but later reinstated by a panel that blamed the crowd. Brutal police tactics are reportedly common in India, according to a recent report by Human Rights Watch in India. Naureen Shah, with Human Rights Watch, stated that the report is based on interviews with 80 police officers, 60 alleged victims, and other experts. 'The police are taking the law into their own hands,' Shah says. 'They are acting as a vigilante force, deciding guilt instead of building a case. They believe harsh measures are necessary for swift justice.' 'Police administrations are meant to protect, but they are becoming predators,' Harcharand Singh says. He is the father of a suspect who he claims died in police custody. Singh and his wife, who are impoverished and partially blind, sat on a bed, tearfully recounting the loss of their son, Pradeep. They stated that police took Pradeep one night, accusing him of involvement in a car theft and shooting. Days later, they say he died in police custody. Police declined to comment on the case or the report. 'We are scared,' said Ram Vati Singh, the mother, through tears. 'What can we do? We have no money to leave or fight the police.' This case was one of many highlighted in the Human Rights Watch report, used as further evidence of what they describe as out-of-control police behavior. However, the report also revealed the difficult conditions police officers work and live in. Many live in police stations for days or even months, unable to go home to see their families due to being on call 24/7. Some work and live in tents in extreme heat. Their bathroom facilities are often inadequate, and their cooking facilities sometimes consist of just bricks and firewood. The high number of cases and the pressure to solve them are intense. Police also report being understaffed. One police official stated that in his jurisdiction, there are 70 police officers for a population of 250,000 people, a figure CNN could not independently verify. There are no computers for reports, so police officers fill everything out by hand. Some departments even run out of paper, according to the Human Rights Watch report. Former Delhi Police Commissioner Ved Marwah says the conditions are dire. 'The policemen are treated inhumanely, which desensitizes and brutalizes them. This is due to their living and working conditions, and their interactions with the public and superiors. This desensitization is reflected in how an average policeman deals with the public.' Marwah says there is also political interference in police investigations. 'Politics plays a very negative role,' he says. 'Today's politicians, both good and bad, see politics as a profession to make a quick buck. When they gain control over the police, they misuse it not to enforce the rule of law, but to help them in their personal endeavors.' Efforts to reform police activities were ordered by India's Supreme Court three years ago. Marwah and Human Rights Watch both agree the ruling was never implemented. However, the current government is promising changes. But Marwah says that until these changes occur, abuses by and to the police will continue unabated. 'Because ultimately, the police, unlike the army, are absolutely under political control,' he says. 'If those who control the police have no will to reform it, then nothing will happen.'
translated_content: UTTAR PRADESH, India (CNN) -- Indický policajt chytí vlasy podozrivej oboma rukami, skrúti ich a zdvihne ju, až kým jej nohy nevisia nad zemou. Podozrivá: 6-ročné dievča obvinené z krádeže 280 rupií, približne 6 dolárov. Incident viedol k prepusteniu jedného policajta a suspendovaniu druhého. Obvinenia voči dievčaťu boli stiahnuté. Udalosť bola zaznamenaná na video vo februári tohto roku. Harcharand Singh a jeho manželka zdieľali svoj príbeh. Pán Singh hovorí, že ich syn, obvinený z krádeže, zomrel vo väzbe. Dva roky predtým, v inom indickom štáte, bol zaznamenaný podobný incident: policajt sa prizeral, ako dav bil obvineného zlodeja. Následne podozrivého zviazal a ťahal ho za motorkou, čo spôsobilo vážne odreniny kože. Obvinený prežil bitie. Dvaja policajti boli v tomto incidente prepustení, ale neskôr ich komisia, ktorá obvinila dav, opäť prijala do služby. Brutálne policajné praktiky sú údajne bežné v Indii, podľa nedávnej správy organizácie Human Rights Watch India. Naureen Shahová z Human Rights Watch uviedla, že správa je založená na rozhovoroch s 80 policajtmi, 60 údajnými obeťami a ďalšími odborníkmi. 'Polícia berie zákon do vlastných rúk,' hovorí Shahová. 'Konajú ako samozvaná strážna sila, rozhodujú o vine namiesto toho, aby budovali prípad. Veria, že prísne opatrenia sú nevyhnutné na rýchle dosiahnutie spravodlivosti.' 'Policajné orgány majú chrániť, ale stávajú sa predátormi,' hovorí Harcharand Singh. Je otcom podozrivého, ktorý podľa jeho tvrdení zomrel vo väzbe. Singh a jeho manželka, ktorí žijú v chudobe a sú čiastočne nevidiaci, sedeli na posteli a so slzami v očiach spomínali na stratu svojho syna Pradeepa. Uviedli, že polícia odviedla Pradeepa jednej noci a obvinila ho zo zapojenia do krádeže auta a streľby. O niekoľko dní neskôr zomrel vo väzbe, ako tvrdia. Polícia sa odmietla vyjadriť k prípadu alebo správe. 'Bojíme sa,' povedala so slzami v očiach Ram Vati Singhová, matka. 'Čo môžeme robiť? Nemáme peniaze na to, aby sme odišli alebo bojovali s políciou.' Tento prípad bol jedným z mnohých, ktoré boli zdôraznené v správe Human Rights Watch a použité ako ďalší dôkaz toho, čo opisujú ako nekontrolovateľné policajné správanie. Správa však tiež odhalila ťažké podmienky, v ktorých policajti pracujú a žijú. Mnohí žijú na policajných staniciach celé dni alebo dokonca mesiace a nemôžu ísť domov za svojimi rodinami, pretože sú neustále v pohotovosti. Niektorí pracujú a žijú v stanoch v extrémnych horúčavách. Ich hygienické zariadenia sú často nevyhovujúce a ich kuchynské zariadenia pozostávajú niekedy len z tehál a dreva. Vysoký počet prípadov a tlak na ich vyriešenie sú enormné. Polícia tiež hlási nedostatok zamestnancov. Jeden policajný úradník uviedol, že v jeho jurisdikcii pripadá 70 policajtov na 250 000 obyvateľov, čo CNN nemohla nezávisle overiť. Neexistujú žiadne počítače na vytváranie správ, takže policajti všetko vypĺňajú ručne. Niektorým oddeleniam dokonca dochádza papier, uvádza sa v správe Human Rights Watch. Bývalý policajný komisár z Dillí Ved Marwah hovorí, že podmienky sú katastrofálne. 'S policajtmi sa zaobchádza neľudsky, čo ich znecitlivuje a vedie k brutalite. Je to spôsobené ich životnými a pracovnými podmienkami a interakciami s verejnosťou a nadriadenými. Toto znecitlivenie sa odráža v tom, ako sa priemerný policajt správa k verejnosti.' Marwah tiež hovorí, že dochádza k politickým zásahom do policajných vyšetrovaní. 'Politika hrá veľmi negatívnu úlohu,' hovorí. 'Dnešní politici, dobrí aj zlí, vnímajú politiku ako prostriedok na rýchle zbohatnutie. Keď získajú kontrolu nad políciou, zneužívajú ju nie na presadzovanie právneho štátu, ale na to, aby im pomohla pri presadzovaní ich osobných záujmov.' Snahy o reformu policajných aktivít nariadil Najvyšší súd Indie pred tromi rokmi. Marwah a Human Rights Watch sa zhodujú, že toto rozhodnutie nebolo nikdy implementované. Súčasná vláda však sľubuje zmeny. Marwah však hovorí, že pokiaľ k týmto zmenám nedôjde, zneužívanie právomocí zo strany polície a voči nej bude pokračovať bez obmedzenia. 'Pretože polícia je v konečnom dôsledku, na rozdiel od armády, absolútne pod politickou kontrolou,' hovorí. 'Ak tí, ktorí ju kontrolujú, nemajú vôľu ju reformovať, potom sa nič nezmení.'

article_content: Following a potential HIV exposure involving a performer, calls have emerged for a production shutdown in California's adult film sector. The Free Speech Coalition, a California trade organization, is advocating a three-day halt following a possible HIV exposure at an out-of-state filming location. The Los Angeles Times noted that the group requested this suspension on Wednesday, though the location of the affected set was not disclosed. This marks another instance where the Coalition has called for a production freeze; a similar event occurred in August after a performer's positive HIV test. That two-day prohibition was, however, lifted when it was determined the result was inaccurate. Diane Duke, the group's CEO, stated she is collaborating with health officials, the company, and the performer to investigate. Duke asked that observers avoid assumptions until more information arises and that the performer's privacy is respected. Since a law mandating condom usage was enacted, porn production has largely migrated from California. An update is expected Friday on whether production can restart and if performers require further HIV checks. Since a law mandating condom use was enacted, production has moved out of California. The city and county issued merely 40 permits for adult films last year – a 90% reduction from 2012 when the rule was implemented. Production teams are reportedly now going to locations like Nevada, Southern California, Florida and Eastern Europe to film. A prior prohibition ended in September, after which performers had to test for HIV and other STIs every 14 days instead of every 28. Previously, an actress known as Cameron Bay gained attention when she, along with her boyfriend, tested positive for HIV. The AIDS Healthcare Foundation, a strong supporter of condom requirements, believes it shows the need for action at the state level.

Los Angeles Times uviedol, že skupina požadovala pozastavenie v stredu, pričom nebolo zverejnené miesto, kde sa dotknutý set nachádzal. Tento dvojdňový zákaz bol však zrušený po tom, čo sa zistilo, že výsledok testu bol falošne pozitívny. Diane Duke, výkonná riaditeľka Free Speech Coalition, uviedla, že spolupracuje so zdravotníckymi úradníkmi, produkčnou spoločnosťou a hercom na vyšetrení incidentu. Herečka Cameron Bay sa v minulosti dostala do médií po tom, čo mala pozitívny test na HIV, rovnako ako jej priateľ, ktorý je tiež hercom. AIDS Healthcare Foundation, ktorá úspešne presadzovala povinné používanie kondómov pre hercov v Los Angeles, uviedla, že táto situácia zdôrazňuje potrebu celoštátnej legislatívy.

article_content: Lord Howell, a former foreign office minister, said stringent immigration and visa checks were harming Britain. Tough immigration policies have made Britain ‘less welcoming’, George Osborne’s father-in-law warned today. Lord Howell, a former foreign office minister, said rules and regulations governing who can enter the country were creating a ‘blot’ on the UK’s reputation. Visa restrictions are damaging Britain's standing on the world stage and need urgent review, he cautioned. The Tories have adopted an increasingly firm stance on immigration, partly to address the rise of the UK Independence Party. This has included efforts to reduce net migration to the tens of thousands and a crackdown on migrants claiming benefits. However, Lord Howell of Guildford said the issue demands ‘very careful management’ and warned the government: ‘We are not getting it right.’ The 78-year-old Tory peer served in Margaret Thatcher's Cabinet and, following the coalition's formation, became a foreign minister for two and a half years. His daughter, Frances, is married to Mr Osborne, the Chancellor. He now chairs a Lords committee on Soft Power, which today released a report warning that British diplomacy is outdated and risks leaving the UK ‘outwitted, out-competed, and increasingly insecure’. Peers cautioned that domestic policies can undermine attempts to build relationships and highlighted how almost every expert who testified before them warned that the Coalition's visa reforms were ‘harming the assets that build the UK's soft power’. They advocate for students to be excluded from net migration targets and a shift in the government's tone when discussing immigration. Lord Howell told BBC Radio 4's Today program that numerous witnesses to the committee had suggested visa and immigration policies were ‘creating a less welcoming atmosphere in Britain’. Business people were being deterred from coming to the UK by a ‘complex web of regulation’, and many students were almost in ‘despair’ due to the restrictions imposed on them. ‘This country has got to be open for business, our leaders say that all the time,’ he said. The comments risk causing embarrassment for George Osborne, who has spent this week visiting towns across the country to demonstrate that business is thriving. ‘Being open for business means we've got to welcome the right people, including many students and highly skilled individuals who contribute to our power in the world, and we've got to keep out those who would obviously do harm to Britain and damage us. ‘This requires very careful handling. We are not getting it right. ‘All our witnesses who came before us - and we had 24 hearings and a vast amount of written evidence - said the visa policy and some of the handling of immigration policy was creating rather a blot, creating a less welcoming atmosphere in Britain when in fact we've got all these fantastic assets which, if we handle them right and tell the story right, can promote a very positive image for Britain, increase our trade, enable us to export more, invest more. ‘Clearly this aspect needs clearing up. Everyone agrees that.’ He said: ‘Many business people who want to relocate to Britain to develop and strengthen our economy are finding it very difficult to navigate the complex web of regulations. ‘And I think many students, particularly from some Commonwealth countries, are finding it really almost a matter of despair trying to get in and, when they have finished, wondering whether they have to return home and all that sort of thing.’

Jeho dcéra Frances je vydatá za pána Osborna, kancelára. Teraz predsedá výboru Snemovne lordov pre mäkkú silu, ktorý dnes zverejnil správu varujúcu, že britská diplomacia je zastaraná a hrozí, že Spojené kráľovstvo zostane ‘prekabátené, prekonané a čoraz neistejšie’. Lordi varovali, že domáce politiky môžu podkopávať pokusy o budovanie vzťahov, a zdôraznili, ako takmer každý expert, ktorý pred nimi svedčil, varoval, že vízové reformy koalície ‘poškodzujú aktíva, ktoré budujú mäkkú silu Spojeného kráľovstva’. Obhajujú, aby študenti boli vylúčení z cieľov čistej migrácie a posun v tóne vlády pri diskusii o imigrácii. Lord Howell pre BBC Radio 4's Today program povedal, že mnohí svedkovia výboru naznačili, že vízové a imigračné politiky ‘vytvárajú menej prívetivú atmosféru v Británii’. Podnikatelia boli odrádzaní od príchodu do Spojeného kráľovstva ‘komplexnou sieťou regulácií’ a mnohí študenti boli takmer v ‘zúfalstve’ kvôli obmedzeniam, ktoré na nich boli uvalené. ‘Táto krajina musí byť otvorená pre podnikanie, naši lídri to hovoria stále,’ povedal. Tieto komentáre riskujú, že spôsobia rozpaky Georgeovi Osborneovi, ktorý tento týždeň strávil návštevami miest po celej krajine, aby preukázal, že podnikanie prosperuje. ‘Byť otvorený pre podnikanie znamená, že musíme privítať správnych ľudí, vrátane mnohých študentov a vysoko kvalifikovaných jednotlivcov, ktorí prispievajú k našej sile vo svete, a musíme vylúčiť tých, ktorí by zjavne poškodili Britániu a uškodili nám. ‘To si vyžaduje veľmi starostlivé riadenie. Nerobíme to správne. ‘Všetci naši svedkovia, ktorí pred nás predstúpili - a mali sme 24 vypočutí a rozsiahle množstvo písomných dôkazov - povedali, že vízová politika a určité zaobchádzanie s imigračnou politikou skôr vytvárali škvrnu, vytvárali menej prívetivú atmosféru v Británii, keď v skutočnosti máme všetky tieto fantastické aktíva, ktoré, ak s nimi budeme správne zaobchádzať a správne ich odprezentujeme, môžu podporiť veľmi pozitívny obraz Británie, zvýšiť náš obchod, umožniť nám viac vyvážať, viac investovať. ‘Je jasné, že tento aspekt je potrebné vyjasniť. Všetci s tým súhlasia.’ Povedal: ‘Mnohí podnikatelia, ktorí sa chcú presťahovať do Británie, aby rozvíjali a posilňovali našu ekonomiku, považujú za veľmi ťažké orientovať sa v komplexnej sieti regulácií. ‘A myslím si, že mnohí študenti, najmä z niektorých krajín Commonwealthu, považujú za naozaj takmer zúfalé pokúsiť sa dostať dnu, a keď skončia, premýšľajú, či sa musia vrátiť domov a všetko podobné.’

article_content: Lewis Hamilton's unfortunate bid for a fifth pole position in Hungary was literally extinguished as his car caught fire early in the qualifying session. Just minutes into the session at the Hungaroring, Hamilton's Mercedes was ablaze at the rear, and his attempt to return to the garage proved futile. Hamilton was forced to stop at the pit lane entry, where marshals quickly extinguished the fire, which Mercedes attributed to a fuel leak. Nico Rosberg secured pole position, positioning him to potentially extend his lead over Hamilton heading into the summer break. The Hungarian GP Grid featured: 1 Rosberg; 2 Vettel; 3 Bottas; 4 Ricciardo; 5 Alonso; 6 Massa; 7 Button; 8 Vergne; 9 Hulkenberg; 10 Magnussen. Rosberg improved on his final run, outpacing Sebastian Vettel by almost half a second. Bottas narrowly missed pole position, finishing just over one tenth of a second behind Rosberg. Magnussen crashed after locking his brakes, causing the session to be suspended while the barrier was repaired. Hamilton stated his engine died after he bailed out of a timed lap due to a brake issue and discovered the car was on fire. Niki Lauda expressed his frustration, deeming the situation unfair, especially given Hamilton's potential to win the race. Mercedes confirmed that a fuel leak caused the fire on Hamilton's car. Hamilton's Mercedes caught fire, forcing him to stop on track and causing him to start at the back of the grid. Christian Horner defended Formula One, urging a focus on the drivers and increased fan engagement. Toto Wolff suffered a wrist fracture in a team-building cycling crash. Niki Lauda apologized to Ferrari for previous remarks. Hamilton had been quickest in all practice sessions ahead of the race. Rosberg leads Hamilton by 14 points before the race.

article_content: In a shocking incident, Edgar Dart, a 56-year-old British man, was fatally shot during a home invasion in the Bahamas. Three masked individuals, armed with a handgun and a machete, stormed into the family's residence on Tuesday morning. According to reports, the intruders confronted Dart's teenage son, George, and several other relatives. When Mr. Dart attempted to intervene, one of the assailants shot him in the chest. The attackers then proceeded to tie up the remaining family members, forcing them to witness Mr. Dart's tragic death. The criminals ransacked the house, making off with cash and valuable jewelry. Philip Poole, Mr. Dart's brother-in-law, revealed that his son, Pip, 29, sustained machete wounds during the attack. He described Edgar as a courageous man who immediately confronted the intruders. The family was reportedly helpless as Mr. Dart lay bleeding for nearly an hour before succumbing to his injuries. They were unable to provide any assistance. Authorities in Grand Bahama are grappling with increasing crime rates, raising fears about potential damage to the island's tourism industry. Joy, Mr. Dart's 79-year-old widowed mother, owns the house where the incident occurred. Other family members present included Dart's brother Colin, his wife Alison, and their son Luke. Alison managed to free herself and alert the authorities, but it was too late to save Mr. Dart. The image of George, bound and gagged while watching his father die, is particularly distressing for the family. Mr. Dart had previously lived in Canada, where he worked as a farmer. His sister, Virginia Redfern, plans to travel to the Bahamas to support the grieving family. Two months prior, the US Embassy had issued a warning about armed robberies targeting American citizens in the Bahamas. Recent incidents included the mugging of American tourists at Jaws Beach. Police have launched an investigation and are appealing to the public for any information that could lead to the arrest of the perpetrators. The Foreign Office has confirmed it is providing consular support. In a statement, the police reported that they received information about a male fatally shot at a residence in the Emerald Bay area. They are actively seeking information to apprehend the gang responsible for this heinous crime.

article_content: The husband of a Texas woman who has been missing since March claims to have a 'completely watertight alibi' for the day of her disappearance, according to his lawyer on Wednesday. Julie Ann Gonzalez was last seen on March 26 by her estranged husband, George De La Cruz. Austin police have stated this week that De La Cruz is a 'person of interest' in her disappearance. However, the husband's lawyer told HLN's 'Issues With Jane Velez-Mitchell' that timeline supports his client's alibi. 'If one examines the timeline of Julie Ann's disappearance and the timeline my client has provided from morning until night, it is physically impossible that he was involved,' attorney Patrick Fagerberg said. 'It is a completely watertight alibi for his whereabouts.' Gonzalez, 21, was last seen on March 26 when she arrived to pick up the couple's 2-year-old daughter. De La Cruz stated that his wife seemed 'out of it' upon arrival, changed her mind about collecting their daughter, and said she would return later. The couple was in the process of divorcing, and Gonzalez had mentioned a new romantic interest to a friend, stating that he was taking her away for the weekend, according to her mother, Sandra Soto, in May. Subsequent to her disappearance, Gonzalez's MySpace page was updated via a mobile phone user to include posts stating 'I wanted to run away' and 'I'm sick of the BS in my life.' Her car, described as almost brand new, was discovered abandoned outside a Walgreen's drug store. Gonzalez was employed as a pharmacy technician at a different Walgreen's location. Since her disappearance, Gonzalez has not accessed her bank account; however, her credit card was used to purchase the movie 'The Spiderwick Chronicles' at an Austin store, her mother reported. Fagerberg acknowledged that De La Cruz purchased the movie. He mentioned spending three hours with detectives on Tuesday, 'reviewing the warrants and providing a logical, innocent explanation for some things in those warrants which may initially appear incriminating.' He concluded, 'When all the facts are revealed, you will find that there is an innocent explanation for everything that occurred that day.'

'Ak sa niekto pozrie na časovú os zmiznutia Julie Ann a na časovú os, ktorú poskytol môj klient od rána do noci, je fyzicky nemožné, aby mal s tým niečo spoločné,' povedal právnik Patrick Fagerberg. 'Je to úplne nepriestrelné alibi pre to, kde sa nachádzal.' Gonzalezovú, ktorá mala 21 rokov, naposledy videli 26. marca, keď prišla vyzdvihnúť dvojročnú dcéru. Po jej zmiznutí bola stránka Gonzalezovej na MySpace aktualizovaná cez mobilný telefón, aby obsahovala príspevky s textom: 'Chcela som utiecť' a 'Už mám dosť tých sračiek v mojom živote.' Jej auto, opísané ako takmer nové, bolo nájdené opustené pred drogériou Walgreen's. Gonzalezová pracovala ako farmaceutická technička v inej pobočke Walgreen's. Na záver povedal: 'Keď sa odhalia všetky fakty, zistíte, že existuje nevinné vysvetlenie pre všetko, čo sa v ten deň stalo.'

article_content: Joanne Cooper, a 31-year-old mother of two, was advised to have an NHS gastric bypass to improve her fertility. She was delighted to give birth to two sons after losing ten stone. The self-employed nail technician from Rotherham has lost a total of 13 stone since undergoing weight loss surgery, as recommended by her doctors. Miss Cooper is now the mother of Noah, three, and Alfie, two. She also had an NHS-funded tummy tuck in June 2013 to remove excess skin that caused irritation. She said she was initially nervous about the gastric bypass but realized it was her best chance to have children. After careful consideration, she decided it was the right choice, despite the potential risks. Miss Cooper's weight increased due to poor eating habits and polycystic ovary syndrome, which she was diagnosed with at 16. She recalls having only one period between the ages of 12 and 17. The PCOS diagnosis explained the weight gain. While she didn't overeat excessively, she had unhealthy eating habits, consuming a lot of chips, pizza, pasta, and takeaways. Working in a pub meant she often consumed high-calorie drinks after work, and late-night takeaways were the only available option after closing at 2am. In September 2012, she started the Cambridge Diet and began going to the gym up to five times a week. Over the next 10 months, she lost six stone. Her typical diet included a protein shake with banana for breakfast, Quorn chili con carne for lunch, and salmon stir-fry for dinner. Miss Cooper's efforts paid off when she lost 10 stone in 18 months. In the spring of 2010, she became pregnant with her first son, Noah, now three. Within eight months of Noah's birth, she conceived her second son, Alfie, now two. By 23, Miss Cooper weighed 23 stone 7lb and wore size 28 clothing. She said she put on a brave face but suffered from back pain and breathlessness. She consulted a doctor about her future fertility and was told that PCOS and her weight problems made conception practically impossible without intervention like a gastric band. She underwent surgery in October 2007 and it took time to adjust to the changes. She experienced sickness if she ate the wrong foods and it took six months to resume normal eating. The weight loss transformed her life. She said she could not have kept up with her children at her previous weight and feels like a completely different, more confident, person. She underwent gastric bypass surgery in October 2007 but the excess skin caused unbearable irritation, leading to a tummy tuck. Joanne was more anxious about the tummy tuck than the bypass. The operation lasted four hours and involved vertical and horizontal incisions. She was relieved that the doctors' plan had worked and overjoyed to have her two sons. However, after Alfie's birth, she gained weight again, reaching 17 stone. She feared returning to her old habits and realized she needed to take action. She restarted the Cambridge Diet in September 2012 and visited the gym regularly, losing six stone in 10 months. Previously, she consumed a bacon sandwich for breakfast, a chip butty with chocolate for lunch, and spaghetti Bolognese with garlic bread for dinner, snacking on sweets and chocolates throughout the day. Currently, she maintains her weight loss by consuming a protein shake with banana for breakfast, Quorn chili con carne for lunch, and salmon stir-fry for dinner, avoiding snacks. When her weight reached 10 stone 7lb, allowing her to wear size eight clothing, the excess skin caused significant discomfort. The transition from over 23 stone to 10 stone 7lb had consequences. She was approved for an NHS tummy tuck, which she had in June 2013. She found the tummy tuck more daunting than the bypass due to the surgery's intensity and potential complications. She is now happy with her appearance and finds it hard to believe the old photos are of her. Her life has completely changed; she can now keep up with her children and feels more confident.
translated_content: Joanne Cooperová, 31-ročná matka dvoch detí, dostala odporúčanie podstúpiť NHS žalúdočný bypass na zlepšenie svojej plodnosti. Táto živnostníčka z Rotherhamu, ktorá pracuje ako nechtová dizajnérka, schudla celkovo 13 kameňov od podstúpenia operácie na zníženie hmotnosti, ktorú jej odporučili lekári. Pani Cooperová je teraz matkou Noeho, ktorý má tri roky, a Alfieho, ktorý má dva roky. V júni 2013 tiež podstúpila NHS-financovanú operáciu brucha na odstránenie prebytočnej kože, ktorá spôsobovala podráždenie. Povedala, že spočiatku mala obavy zo žalúdočného bypassu, ale uvedomila si, že je to jej najlepšia šanca mať deti. Po dôkladnom zvážení sa rozhodla, že je to správna voľba, napriek potenciálnym rizikám. Hmotnosť pani Cooperovej sa zvýšila kvôli zlým stravovacím návykom a syndrómu polycystických ovárií, ktorý jej diagnostikovali v 16 rokoch. Spomína si, že mala len jednu menštruáciu medzi 12 a 17 rokom. Diagnóza PCOS vysvetlila nárast hmotnosti. Hoci sa neprejedala nadmerne, mala nezdravé stravovacie návyky, konzumovala veľa hranolčekov, pizze, cestovín a jedál so sebou. Práca v krčme znamenala, že často konzumovala vysokokalorické nápoje po práci a neskoré nočné jedlá so sebou boli jedinou dostupnou možnosťou po zatvorení o 2:00 ráno. V septembri 2012 začala s Cambridge diétou a začala chodiť do posilňovne až päťkrát týždenne. Počas nasledujúcich 10 mesiacov schudla šesť kameňov. Jej typická strava zahŕňala proteínový kokteil s banánom na raňajky, Quorn chili con carne na obed a lososa pripraveného štýlom stir-fry na večeru. Úsilie pani Cooperovej sa vyplatilo, keď schudla 10 kameňov za 18 mesiacov. Na jar 2010 otehotnela so svojím prvým synom Noem, ktorý má teraz tri roky. Do ôsmich mesiacov od Noeho narodenia počala svojho druhého syna Alfieho, ktorý má teraz dva roky. Vo veku 23 rokov vážila pani Cooperová 23 kameňov a 7 libier a nosila oblečenie veľkosti 28. Povedala, že si nasadila statočnú tvár, ale trpela bolesťami chrbta a dýchavičnosťou. Konzultovala s lekárom o svojej budúcej plodnosti a bolo jej povedané, že PCOS a jej problémy s hmotnosťou prakticky znemožňujú počatie bez intervencie, ako je žalúdočná bandáž. Operáciu podstúpila v októbri 2007 a trvalo nejaký čas, kým sa prispôsobila zmenám. Pociťovala nevoľnosť, ak jedla nesprávne jedlá, a trvalo šesť mesiacov, kým sa vrátila k normálnemu jedeniu. Chudnutie jej zmenilo život. Povedala, že by nedokázala držať krok so svojimi deťmi pri svojej predchádzajúcej hmotnosti a cíti sa ako úplne iná, sebavedomejšia osoba. Podstúpila operáciu žalúdočného bypassu v októbri 2007, ale prebytočná koža spôsobovala neznesiteľné podráždenie, čo viedlo k operácii brucha. Joanne mala väčšie obavy z operácie brucha ako z bypassu. Operácia trvala štyri hodiny a zahŕňala vertikálne aj horizontálne rezy. Bola rada, že lekársky plán fungoval, a bola nadšená, že má svojich dvoch synov. Avšak po Alfieho narodení opäť pribrala a dosiahla 17 kameňov. Obávala sa návratu k starým návykom a uvedomila si, že musí konať. V septembri 2012 opäť začala s Cambridge diétou a pravidelne navštevovala posilňovňu, pričom za 10 mesiacov schudla šesť kameňov. Predtým konzumovala na raňajky sendvič so slaninou, na obed hranolky s čokoládou a na večeru špagety Bolognese s cesnakovým chlebom, pričom medzi jedlami jedla sladkosti a čokolády. V súčasnosti si udržiava svoju váhu konzumáciou proteínového kokteilu s banánom na raňajky, Quorn chili con carne na obed a lososa pripraveného štýlom stir-fry na večeru, pričom sa vyhýba maškrtám. Keď jej váha dosiahla 10 kameňov a 7 libier, čo jej umožnilo nosiť oblečenie veľkosti osem, prebytočná koža spôsobovala značný diskomfort. Prechod z viac ako 23 kameňov na 10 kameňov a 7 libier mal svoje následky. Bola schválená pre NHS operáciu brucha, ktorú podstúpila v júni 2013. Operácia brucha sa jej zdala náročnejšia ako bypass kvôli rozsahu operácie a potenciálnym komplikáciám. Teraz je spokojná so svojím vzhľadom a ťažko uverí, že staré fotografie sú jej. Jej život sa úplne zmenil; teraz dokáže držať krok so svojimi deťmi a cíti sa sebavedomejšie.

article_content: The U.S. Office of Special Counsel has determined that Northwest Airlines, now part of Delta Airlines, violated more than 1,000 safety regulations issued by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). This finding supports claims made by an FAA whistleblower. The investigation revealed that Northwest demonstrated 'systemic non-compliance with FAA Airworthiness Directives,' which are government rules intended to remedy potentially unsafe conditions. According to the Office of Special Counsel, despite Northwest's history of not adhering to Airworthiness Directives, FAA inspectors continued to collaborate with the airline to address issues. Instead of issuing civil penalties, the FAA primarily resolved enforcement cases by sending letters of correction. Mark Lund, a whistleblower from the FAA's former Northwest inspection office in Bloomington, Minnesota, alleged that in 2008, the airline lacked sufficient policies and procedures to ensure compliance with safety regulations. Associate Special Counsel William Reukauf confirmed in a letter to President Barack Obama that 'The investigation substantiated Mr. Lund's allegations.' In response to these findings, FAA Administrator Randy Babbitt established a review team to oversee the carrier's compliance. Furthermore, the FAA has proposed disciplinary actions against two Northwest managers. The FAA released a statement on Thursday indicating that it 'has taken corrective action on the issues identified in the whistleblower complaint and is continuing to monitor compliance.'

Toto zistenie podporuje tvrdenia informátora FAA. Vyšetrovanie odhalilo, že spoločnosť Northwest preukázala 'systematické nedodržiavanie smerníc FAA o letovej spôsobilosti', čo sú vládne pravidlá určené na nápravu potenciálne nebezpečných podmienok. Podľa Úradu špeciálneho vyšetrovateľa, napriek tomu, že spoločnosť Northwest v minulosti nedodržiavala smernice o letovej spôsobilosti, inšpektori FAA naďalej spolupracovali s leteckou spoločnosťou na riešení problémov. Namiesto ukladania občianskoprávnych sankcií FAA riešila prípady presadzovania práva predovšetkým zasielaním opravných listov. Mark Lund, informátor z bývalej inšpekčnej kancelárie FAA pre Northwest v Bloomingtone v Minnesote, tvrdil, že v roku 2008 letecká spoločnosť nemala zavedené dostatočné zásady a postupy na zabezpečenie súladu s bezpečnostnými predpismi. Zástupca špeciálneho vyšetrovateľa William Reukauf v liste prezidentovi Barackovi Obamovi potvrdil, že 'Vyšetrovanie potvrdilo tvrdenia pána Lunda.' V reakcii na tieto zistenia administrátor FAA Randy Babbitt zriadil revízny tím na dohľad nad dodržiavaním predpisov dopravcom. Okrem toho FAA navrhla disciplinárne opatrenia proti dvom manažérom spoločnosti Northwest. article_content: The specter of fear in politics, reminiscent of the post-9/11 era, has resurfaced following ISIS's execution of American citizens. With the midterm elections looming just six weeks away, national security anxieties could unexpectedly reshape the political landscape. Across the nation, Republican candidates are capitalizing on the ISIS threat, employing a time-tested tactic of portraying their Democratic rivals as lacking strength in national security matters. Shortly after U.S. and coalition forces conducted new airstrikes in Syria, Scott Brown, a Republican vying for a Senate seat in New Hampshire, launched an advertisement featuring a stark image of a militant brandishing an ISIS flag. In the ad, Brown, a retired Army National Guard member, emphasizes his own military background before juxtaposing images of his Democratic opponent, Jeanne Shaheen, and President Obama, asserting that they appear uncertain about the gravity of the threat, a sentiment he claims to not share. This advertisement carries particular weight in New Hampshire, given that James Foley, the American journalist murdered by ISIS, hailed from the state. According to Republican strategists, such advertisements are informed by voter data gathered from focus groups and polling nationwide, indicating that security is increasingly paramount for voters, especially married women, a demographic crucial to Republican success in midterm elections. Neil Newhouse, a Republican pollster, notes that security has unexpectedly become a top-tier concern. Newhouse's research on 'Walmart Moms'—female voters with children under 18 who regularly shop at Walmart—revealed heightened concern about ISIS during recent focus groups in key battleground states like Arkansas and Iowa, a sentiment not commonly observed in previous studies. Rep. Greg Walden also noted the growing prominence of national security in opinion polls. The National Republican Congressional Committee has responded by releasing several security-themed television advertisements in competitive races, some of which warn that Democratic policies render them 'dangerous' in the face of ISIS threats. Walden believes that 'security moms' are already leaning toward Republican candidates, and this issue could solidify their support and ensure their participation in the election. Further demonstrating the Republican commitment to this security-focused strategy, two new advertisements were released, echoing the approach employed by the GOP in 2002 and 2004. Former Georgia Sen. Max Cleland recalls a similar experience, where his opponent attacked his national security credentials despite Cleland's distinguished military service in Vietnam. Cleland advises Democrats facing similar attacks to vigorously defend themselves and expose what he considers dishonest tactics. He argues that Republicans will exploit any advantage available, including security concerns. Shaheen has released a statement affirming her support for decisive action against ISIS. Similarly, in North Carolina, Sen. Kay Hagan is being targeted for allegedly neglecting the terror threat, although her staff maintains she has focused on counterterrorism efforts. Democrats are showing signs of concern that these fear-based tactics might be effective. Former Iowa state Rep. Staci Appel, responded to an attack ad accusing her of not supporting the revocation of passports for suspected terrorists, vehemently denying the claim. However, Democratic pollster Anna Greenberg argues that the concept of a 'security mom' is a myth, cautioning against equating concern about terrorism with its influence on voting decisions. She suggests that voters primarily look to the President and the military for security, not members of Congress, and that the current situation is significantly different from the immediate aftermath of 9/11. While GOP pollster Neil Newhouse agrees that security concerns are lower than in the elections following 9/11, he maintains that they still resonate, particularly given the proximity of the ISIS beheadings to the election. Rep. Steve Israel believes that economic issues will be the primary driver of voter decisions, arguing that the GOP strategy will alienate independent voters by fostering division. Walden, however, insists that discussing security on the campaign trail is legitimate and reflects the concerns of voters in light of recent events in the Middle East.
translated_content: Vízia strachu v politike, pripomínajúca obdobie po 11. septembri, sa opäť objavila po poprave amerických občanov skupinou ISIS. S blížiacimi sa voľbami v polovici volebného obdobia, ktoré sa konajú už o šesť týždňov, by obavy o národnú bezpečnosť mohli neočakávane pretvoriť politickú krajinu. Republikánski kandidáti po celej krajine ťažia z hrozby ISIS a používajú osvedčenú taktiku zobrazovania svojich demokratických súperov ako slabých v otázkach národnej bezpečnosti. Krátko po tom, čo americké a koaličné sily uskutočnili nové letecké útoky v Sýrii, Scott Brown, republikánsky kandidát na senátora v New Hampshire, spustil reklamu so zarážajúcim obrázkom militanta mávajúceho vlajkou ISIS. V reklame Brown, člen Národnej gardy v zálohe, zdôrazňuje svoje vlastné vojenské zázemie predtým, ako postaví vedľa seba obrázky svojej demokratickej súperky Jeanne Shaheen a prezidenta Obamu, pričom tvrdí, že sa zdajú byť neistí ohľadom závažnosti hrozby, čo je pocit, ktorý on nezdieľa. Táto reklama má osobitnú váhu v New Hampshire, vzhľadom na to, že James Foley, americký novinár zavraždený ISIS, pochádzal z tohto štátu. Podľa republikánskych stratégov sú takéto reklamy založené na údajoch o voličoch získaných z cieľových skupín a prieskumov verejnej mienky v celej krajine, čo naznačuje, že bezpečnosť je pre voličov čoraz dôležitejšia, najmä pre vydaté ženy, čo je demografická skupina kľúčová pre republikánsky úspech v strednodobých voľbách. Neil Newhouse, republikánsky anketár, poznamenáva, že bezpečnosť sa neočakávane stala prvoradou obavou. Newhouseov výskum o „Walmart Moms“ – voličkách s deťmi do 18 rokov, ktoré pravidelne nakupujú vo Walmarte – odhalil zvýšené obavy z ISIS počas nedávnych fokusových skupín v kľúčových štátoch, ako sú Arkansas a Iowa, čo je sentiment, ktorý sa v predchádzajúcich štúdiách bežne nepozoroval. Republikán Greg Walden tiež poznamenal rastúci význam národnej bezpečnosti v prieskumoch verejnej mienky. Národný republikánsky výbor pre Kongres reagoval zverejnením niekoľkých televíznych reklám s tematikou bezpečnosti v konkurenčných pretekoch, z ktorých niektoré varujú, že demokratická politika ich robí „nebezpečnými“ zoči-voči hrozbám ISIS. Walden sa domnieva, že „bezpečnostné mamičky“ sa už prikláňajú k republikánskym kandidátom a táto otázka by mohla upevniť ich podporu a zabezpečiť ich účasť vo voľbách. Ďalším dôkazom republikánskeho odhodlania pre túto stratégiu zameranú na bezpečnosť bolo zverejnenie dvoch nových reklám, ktoré odrážajú prístup GOP z rokov 2002 a 2004. Bývalý senátor za Georgiu Max Cleland si spomína na podobnú skúsenosť, keď jeho súper útočil na jeho dôveryhodnosť v oblasti národnej bezpečnosti napriek Clelandovej významnej vojenskej službe vo Vietname. Cleland radí demokratom, ktorí čelia podobným útokom, aby sa energicky bránili a odhalili to, čo považuje za nečestné taktiky. Tvrdí, že republikáni využijú každú dostupnú výhodu, vrátane obáv o bezpečnosť. Shaheenová vydala vyhlásenie, v ktorom potvrdila svoju podporu rozhodným krokom proti ISIS. Podobne je v Severnej Karolíne senátorka Kay Haganová terčom útokov za údajné zanedbávanie teroristickej hrozby, hoci jej štáb tvrdí, že sa zamerala na protiteroristické úsilie. Demokrati prejavujú známky obáv, že táto taktika založená na strachu by mohla byť účinná. Bývalá štátna zástupkyňa za Iowu Staci Appelová reagovala na útočnú reklamu, ktorá ju obviňovala z toho, že nepodporuje odobratie pasov podozrivým teroristom, a dôrazne toto tvrdenie poprela. Demokratická anketárka Anna Greenbergová však tvrdí, že koncept „bezpečnostnej mamičky“ je mýtus, pričom varuje pred stotožňovaním obáv z terorizmu s jeho vplyvom na rozhodovanie o hlasovaní. Naznačuje, že voliči sa primárne obracajú na prezidenta a armádu v otázkach bezpečnosti, nie na členov Kongresu, a že súčasná situácia je výrazne odlišná od bezprostredného obdobia po 11. septembri. Hoci republikánsky anketár Neil Newhouse súhlasí s tým, že obavy o bezpečnosť sú nižšie ako vo voľbách po 11. septembri, tvrdí, že stále rezonujú, najmä vzhľadom na blízkosť popráv ISIS k voľbám. Republikán Steve Israel sa domnieva, že hospodárske otázky budú hlavným hnacím motorom rozhodovania voličov, pričom tvrdí, že stratégia GOP odcudzí nezávislých voličov podnecovaním rozdelenia. Walden však trvá na tom, že diskusia o bezpečnosti na predvolebnej trati je legitímna a odráža obavy voličov v súvislosti s nedávnymi udalosťami na Blízkom východe.

article_content: At the Kassam Stadium, London Welsh suffered a 23-3 defeat against Newcastle, their sixth consecutive loss in the Aviva Premiership. Newcastle controlled the match, displaying greater creativity with Scott Lawson and Mark Wilson prominent in the forwards. Juan Pablo Socino directed play from fly-half, enabling Adam Powell and Sinoti Sinoti to showcase their attacking abilities. Powell, Wilson, and Ruki Tipuna each scored a try for the visitors, while Socino added two penalties and Rory Clegg kicked a conversion. Olly Barkley's penalty was the only score for Welsh, who now trail the Falcons by eight points. Following the previous week's substantial loss to Harlequins, London Welsh altered their starting line-up with five changes. Chris Hala'ufia, a recent loan signing, debuted at No 8, and Pablo Henn, Nathan Morris, Richard Thorpe, and Matt Corker returned as Welsh aimed for their first victory of the season. Newcastle remained unchanged after securing their first Premiership win of the season against Exeter the previous Sunday, and they took an early lead with Socino's excellent penalty from the touchline. Welsh quickly responded with Barkley's penalty, but the visitors dominated the initial 15 minutes and justly scored the game's first try. Socino's pass to Dom Barrow penetrated the home defense, Barrow then passed to Mark Wilson, who set up Powell for the try; Socino missed the subsequent conversion. Welsh experienced another setback when prop Taione Vea was replaced by Jack Gilding due to injury, and they nearly conceded another try. A Welsh attack broke down near half-way, allowing Socino to kick deep into the Welsh in-goal area. Morris narrowly won the race for the touchdown, preventing Sinoti from scoring. Basic errors prevented Welsh from gaining momentum, and after 28 minutes, they fell further behind as Socino converted his second penalty. Halau'fia then made a significant tackle on Falcons' prop Scott Lawson, prompting referee Wayne Barnes to review the replay multiple times. Eventually, a penalty was awarded to the visitors, but Socino's attempt hit the post. Newcastle's Gonzalo Tiesi left the game due to injury, replaced by Clegg, but this didn't halt their progress as they scored a second try just before half-time. Powell and Sinoti combined effectively to create an opportunity in the opposition's 22, leading to Mark Wilson's try, giving the Falcons a 16-3 lead at half-time. The initial ten minutes of the second half marked Welsh's strongest period in the match. Inspired by Hala'ufia, they pressured the Falcons' line but failed to break through their solid defense, and Newcastle capitalized immediately by scoring a decisive try. Sinotti and Wilson again linked up, providing Tipuna with an easy try, which Clegg converted. Newcastle made numerous substitutions, enabling the home side to control the final quarter. With 11 minutes remaining, Wilson received a yellow card as the Falcons struggled to halt Welsh's advances, but even with a man advantage, Welsh couldn't score.

Socino prihrávkou na Doma Barrowa prenikol cez domácu obranu, Barrow následne prihrál Markovi Wilsonovi, ktorý pripravil päťkový hod pre Powella; Socino následne minul konverziu. Welsh zaznamenal ďalší neúspech, keď bol Taione Vea stiahnutý z ihriska pre zranenie a nahradený Jackom Gildingom a takmer inkasovali ďalší päťkový hod. Útočná akcia Welsh sa rozpadla v blízkosti polovice ihriska, čo umožnilo Socinovi nakopnúť loptu hlboko do bránkoviska Welsh. Morris tesne vyhral súboj o loptu v bránkovisku a zabránil Sinotimu skórovať. Jednoduché chyby bránili Welsh v získaní tempa a po 28 minútach prehrávali ešte viac, keď Socino premenil svoju druhú penaltu. Halau'fia potom tvrdo zložil piliera Falcons, Scotta Lawsona, čo prinútilo rozhodcu Wayna Barnesa, aby si niekoľkokrát pozrel záznam. Nakoniec bola hosťom prisúdená penalta, ale Socinov pokus skončil na tyči. Gonzalo Tiesi z Newcastlu odstúpil z hry kvôli zraneniu, nahradený bol Cleggom, ale to nezastavilo ich postup, keď položili druhý päťkový hod tesne pred polčasom. Powell a Sinoti efektívne spolupracovali na vytvorení príležitosti na útočnej polovici súpera, čo viedlo k päťkovému hodu Marka Wilsona a zabezpečilo pre Falcons vedenie 16-3 v polčase. Prvých desať minút druhého polčasu predstavovalo pre Welsh najsilnejšiu pasáž v zápase. Inšpirovaní Hala'ufiom zatlačili na líniu Falcons, ale nedokázali prelomiť ich pevnú obranu a Newcastle okamžite využil situáciu a položil rozhodujúci päťkový hod. Sinoti a Wilson opäť spolupracovali a pripravili Tipunovi ľahký päťkový hod, ktorý Clegg premenil. Newcastle vykonal niekoľko striedaní, čo umožnilo domácemu tímu kontrolovať záverečnú štvrtinu zápasu. 11 minút pred koncom bol Wilson vylúčený žltou kartou, keďže sa Falcons snažili zastaviť útočné snahy Welsh, ale ani s výhodou jedného hráča Welsh nedokázali skórovať.

article_content: A disturbing image has been released showing the four-foot metal box in which two marijuana growers allegedly held a 15-year-old girl as a sex slave. The photograph of the unnamed victim's coffin-like prison was presented in court today during the appearance of her alleged captors, Ryan Balletto, 30, and Patrick Pearmain, 24, before a judge in Northern California. The two men are charged with conspiracy to manufacture and distribute over 1,000 marijuana plants. Additionally, Pearmain is charged with kidnapping to commit robbery or rape and unlawful sex with a minor, while Balletto faces charges of lewd and lascivious acts with a child. Authorities stated that the men confined the girl in the four-foot long, two-foot wide, and two-foot high box to prevent her from disrupting the 'mission,' their code word for the marijuana operation. The box was positioned at an angle, and a hose was inserted 'to wash her off and rinse human waste from the inside without letting her out,' according to police. The girl's current location and condition have not been disclosed. Court records indicate that the suspects appeared before a federal judge for a brief three-minute hearing on Wednesday, but did not enter any pleas. Their arraignment is scheduled for Friday in federal court. The teen was reported missing from Los Angeles in April and was found a month later at the marijuana farm following a large-scale drug bust. The Los Angeles Police Department described the 15-year-old girl as a runaway and believe she was kidnapped by Balletto and Pearmain and taken to their growing operation in Lake County, California. According to a criminal complaint, she was locked in the small box for days when she was not being used to harvest marijuana. The toolbox had holes for ventilation and a blanket. Another hole allowed them to run a hose through it to clean out human waste without releasing her. It was spray-painted with 'an animal skull surrounding the shadow image of a human skull with the logo 'bone collector.' After her rescue, the girl recalled being in the box for three days on two separate occasions. Balletto reportedly called her a 'trooper' for not screaming while confined. She was also warned 'not to (expletive) up' because the men had a 'whole lot of money on the (marijuana) grow.' In addition to the toolbox, police discovered a homemade wooden rack used for sexual bondage, a noose, two dildos, and a white towel with blood stains. LAPD contacted the Lake County Police Department, suggesting Balletto may have been responsible for the girl's kidnapping. Officers visited Balletto's house on April 29 to inquire about the teen. The following day, the girl called police to report that she was okay. Authorities traced the call to her location at a West Sacramento motel, where the two men were arrested and the teen was taken into protective custody. Upon arresting the men, police found a notebook containing what appeared to be a script for the girl's phone call to police. 'They think I'm missing' and 'I just want to make sure Ryan Balletto doesn't get in any trouble' were lines from the script. The girl told investigators that both men had sex with her, claiming it was consensual with Pearmain. Since she is a minor, officers informed her that she is 'legally unable' to consent to sex with an adult. She described the sex with Balletto as 'not as consensual' and stated that she did it to 'help him out.' Federal investigators suspect there may be additional victims. Police later raided Balletto's grow operation and home, seizing 1,400 marijuana plants, $4,000 in cash, and 'the largest and most sophisticated bulk of weapons seized in recent (department) history.' They found 22 firearms, including high-powered military-grade sniper and assault rifles, automatic assault rifles, and pistols. Many of the firearms were loaded. Alongside the firearms, they found military-grade body armor and scopes, high-capacity magazines, and ammunition. Balletto's girlfriend, Christa McConnell, was also arrested. She faces child endangerment charges for leaving loaded weapons within reach of her five children. Authorities found most of the firearms in a safe at Balletto's house. A ponytail of hair was also found in the safe. McConnell has five children with Balletto, according to the criminal complaint. During the raid, a 7-month-old baby was found sleeping on the master bed with a loaded gun only two feet from the headboard. All five children were placed in the custody of Lake County Child Protective Services. McConnell faces child-endangerment and weapons charges. Last year, Lake County had 87 cases of residents cultivating marijuana. According to public information releases on the Sheriff's Office website, police have eradicated nearly 60,000 marijuana plants this month alone. 'Some in our community believe that marijuana grow operations are run by compassionate caregivers interested only in supplying medicine to the sick,' U.S. Attorney Melinda Haag said in a written statement. 'Unfortunately, this case illustrates what we in law enforcement see - marijuana grow operations that include heavily armed, violent individuals, motivated by profit, carrying out abuse of vulnerable victims.'

article_content: Contrary to common belief, young individuals are indeed mindful of the economy and their financial situations, as emphasized by Kelly Evans, a 23-year-old economics reporter from The Wall Street Journal. Evans, who began covering economics during an economic downturn, has observed the adaptability of her generation amidst a shifting employment landscape. In an interview with CNN's Nicole Lapin, Evans shared insights on how young people can navigate these challenging times. Evans stresses the importance of understanding that economics directly influences various aspects of life, including employment, income levels, demographic trends, and poverty rates across the nation. While economic terminology may seem daunting initially, she encourages readers to delve into financial coverage to grasp its relevance. Evans also highlights the proactive role her and her team have taken in identifying and reporting potential economic risks, ensuring that these issues don't come as a surprise. When asked about key areas of focus for young individuals, Evans points to career development and job prospects as paramount. She notes that students, whether in high school or college, are increasingly considering their future career paths, with fields like healthcare and education gaining prominence over traditional sectors like banking. Evans advises young people to prioritize their financial stability by investing in education and acquiring valuable skills, such as language proficiency, which can significantly enhance their human capital. Furthermore, Evans urges prospective college students to prioritize value over prestige when selecting an institution, emphasizing the importance of obtaining an education that offers the best return on investment.

article_content: Following many complaints from unhappy customers, regulators have directed the discount website Groupon to improve its business practices. Groupon is now prohibited from overstating the savings offered in its daily voucher promotions. The company must also guarantee that businesses providing discounted goods and services—ranging from fish pedicures to cupcakes—are capable of fulfilling customer demand. Furthermore, any claims made about the health or beauty products it promotes will need to be supported by evidence. A streamlined refund process will also need to be established. This action follows an investigation by the Office of Fair Trading (OFT), which recently announced that Groupon has committed legally to improving how it operates. Should Groupon fail to implement these changes within a three-month timeframe, it could face fines and legal repercussions. The Advertising Standards Authority (ASA) initially brought the matter to the OFT, revealing that customers had been misled by a minimum of 48 deals promoted by Groupon and its partners in just 11 months. As an intermediary for businesses nationwide, the American company offers online vouchers for their services and products, emailing over six million subscribers in Britain daily with offers promoted as bargains. However, these deals are only valid if a certain number of people sign up. Some customers have been disappointed by smaller businesses struggling to meet demand, while others have complained about Groupon inflating the discount amounts. Cavendish Elithorn from the OFT noted that while group buying and discount programs can benefit both consumers and businesses, it’s crucial that consumers are protected by consumer law alongside discounted offers. He added that Groupon cooperated fully with their investigation and is making changes to address the concerns. They will closely monitor the situation to ensure consumers benefit from these improvements. Groupon has stated its willingness to implement the OFT's recommended changes, mentioning that many were already in progress. Groupon apologized to customers who experienced negative effects from the company's growth, saying they are committed to providing the best customer service and are sorry for falling short. The company said it would continue striving to get things right and wants to be known for providing the best customer service in the UK.

Groupon má teraz zakázané preháňať úspory ponúkané vo svojich denných zľavových akciách. Spoločnosť musí tiež zaručiť, že podniky poskytujúce zľavnené tovary a služby – od pedikúry s rybičkami po cupcakes – sú schopné uspokojiť dopyt zákazníkov. Okrem toho, akékoľvek tvrdenia o zdravotných alebo kozmetických produktoch, ktoré propaguje, musia byť podložené dôkazmi. Bude tiež potrebné zaviesť efektívny proces vrátenia peňazí. Toto opatrenie nasleduje po vyšetrovaní Úradom pre spravodlivé obchodovanie (OFT), ktorý nedávno oznámil, že sa Groupon právne zaviazal zlepšiť spôsob, akým funguje. Ak spoločnosť Groupon nezavedie tieto zmeny v priebehu troch mesiacov, môže čeliť pokutám a právnym následkom. Úrad pre reguláciu reklamy (ASA) pôvodne postúpil záležitosť úradu OFT a odhalil, že zákazníci boli oklamaní minimálne 48 ponukami propagovanými spoločnosťou Groupon a jej partnermi za obdobie iba 11 mesiacov. Ako sprostredkovateľ pre podniky po celej krajine, americká spoločnosť ponúka online poukazy na svoje služby a produkty a denne posiela e-maily viac ako šiestim miliónom britských odberateľov s ponukami prezentovanými ako výhodné. Tieto ponuky sú však platné len vtedy, ak sa prihlási určitý počet ľudí. Niektorí zákazníci boli sklamaní menšími podnikmi, ktoré mali problémy s uspokojením dopytu, zatiaľ čo iní sa sťažovali na to, že spoločnosť Groupon preháňa výšku zliav. Cavendish Elithorn z OFT poznamenal, že hoci skupinové nakupovanie a zľavové programy môžu byť prínosom pre spotrebiteľov aj podniky, je dôležité, aby boli spotrebitelia chránení spotrebiteľským právom, ako aj zľavnenými ponukami. Dodal, že spoločnosť Groupon plne spolupracovala pri vyšetrovaní a pracuje na zmenách na vyriešenie týchto problémov. Budú pozorne sledovať situáciu, aby zabezpečili, že spotrebitelia budú mať z týchto zlepšení úžitok. Spoločnosť Groupon uviedla, že je ochotná implementovať zmeny odporúčané úradom OFT a uviedla, že mnohé z nich už boli v procese realizácie. Spoločnosť Groupon sa ospravedlnila zákazníkom, ktorí mali negatívne skúsenosti v dôsledku rastu spoločnosti, a uviedla, že sa zaviazala poskytovať najlepšie služby zákazníkom a je jej ľúto, že nesplnila ich očakávania. Spoločnosť uviedla, že bude pokračovať v úsilí o zlepšenie a chce byť známa poskytovaním najlepších služieb zákazníkom v Spojenom kráľovstve.

article_content: They're on display at cash registers across America: candy bars, packs of gum, and little cigars. In some cases, these cigars aren't tucked away behind the counter where only the attendant can reach them but are displayed right in front for anyone to pick up. Traditional, larger cigars represent a small portion of today's cigar industry. Newer types of tobacco products include cigarette-sized cigars, or little cigars, designed to resemble typical cigarettes but avoid cigarette taxes and regulations. Flavored little cigars can be sold virtually anywhere, and children are a primary target market for these products. Unlike cigarettes, many are sold individually or in small, low-priced packs, costing a fraction of a cigarette in most states. These little cigars have names like 'Da Bomb Blueberry' and 'Swagberry'. The flavors themselves—chocolate mint, watermelon, wild cherry, and more—can mask the harsh taste of tobacco and are appealing to children. The Food and Drug Administration banned candy and fruit flavors in cigarettes to discourage young people from starting to smoke, but this ban didn't cover cigars. The tobacco industry claims its marketing efforts are solely aimed at adults. It has long argued that its marketing doesn't increase demand or cause young people to smoke but is intended to increase brand appeal and market share among existing adult smokers. How many adults do you know who smoke grape-flavored cigars? The CDC reports more teens are smoking flavored tobacco. Little cigars have become more popular in recent years, with flavored brands holding almost 80% of the market share. In 2011, among middle school and high school students who currently smoke cigars, more than one in three reported using flavored little cigars. Six states—Florida, Georgia, Maryland, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, and Wisconsin—have youth cigar smoking rates that are the same as or higher than youth cigarette smoking rates. Despite the tobacco industry's statements, the link between marketing and youth tobacco use is clear. Some legislative and regulatory actions addressing tax discrepancies, youth appeal, and marketing are in place or under consideration. New York and Providence, Rhode Island, have enacted city-wide ordinances prohibiting the sale of flavored tobacco products, including flavored little cigars. Both ordinances have been challenged and upheld in U.S. District Court. In April, the Tobacco Tax and Enforcement Reform Act was introduced in the Senate, aiming to eliminate tax disparities between different tobacco products, reduce illegal tobacco trade, and increase the federal excise tax on tobacco products. Based on decades of evidence, the 2012 Surgeon General's report on tobacco use among youth and young adults concluded that tobacco industry marketing causes youth to smoke, and nicotine addiction keeps them smoking. This sobering fact holds true despite bans on advertising and promotions targeting children and youth and restrictions on certain other marketing activities. Nearly 90% of smokers started before they were 18 years old, and almost no one starts smoking after age 25. To prevent the needless death, disability, and illness caused by smoking, we must stop young people from starting to smoke. A key part of prevention efforts must be action that eliminates loopholes in restrictions on tobacco marketing, pricing, and products that encourage children and youth to smoke. It's not too much to expect of our society to protect our kids so they can reach adulthood without an addiction that can harm or kill them. A CDC survey finds 'emerging' tobacco products are gaining traction among young people. The opinions expressed are solely those of Dr. Tom Frieden.
translated_content: Sú vystavené pri pokladniach po celej Amerike: cukríky, žuvačky a malé cigary. V niektorých prípadoch tieto cigary nie sú schované za pultom, kde sa k nim dostane len obsluha, ale sú vystavené priamo vpredu, aby si ich mohol vziať ktokoľvek. Tradičné, väčšie cigary predstavujú malú časť súčasného cigaretového priemyslu. Nové typy tabakových výrobkov zahŕňajú cigary veľkosti cigariet, alebo malé cigary, navrhnuté tak, aby sa podobali typickým cigaretám, ale obchádzajú dane a regulácie pre cigarety. Ochutené malé cigary sa môžu predávať prakticky kdekoľvek a deti sú hlavným cieľovým trhom pre tieto produkty. Na rozdiel od cigariet sa mnohé predávajú jednotlivo alebo v malých, lacných baleniach, ktoré stoja zlomok ceny cigarety vo väčšine štátov. Tieto malé cigary majú názvy ako 'Da Bomb Blueberry' a 'Swagberry'. Samotné príchute – čokoládová mäta, melón, divoká čerešňa a ďalšie – môžu maskovať drsnú chuť tabaku a sú príťažlivé pre deti. Úrad pre kontrolu potravín a liečiv (FDA) zakázal cukrové a ovocné príchute v cigaretách, aby odradil mladých ľudí od fajčenia, ale tento zákaz sa nevzťahoval na cigary. Tabakový priemysel tvrdí, že jeho marketingové úsilie je zamerané výlučne na dospelých. Dlhodobo tvrdí, že jeho marketing nezvyšuje dopyt ani nespôsobuje fajčenie mladých ľudí, ale je zameraný na zvýšenie príťažlivosti značky a podielu na trhu medzi existujúcimi dospelými fajčiarmi. Koľko dospelých poznáte, ktorí fajčia cigary s hroznovou príchuťou? CDC uvádza, že viac tínedžerov fajčí ochutený tabak. Malé cigary sa v posledných rokoch stali populárnejšími, pričom ochutené značky majú takmer 80 % podiel na trhu. V roku 2011 viac ako tretina žiakov stredných a vysokých škôl, ktorí v súčasnosti fajčia cigary, uviedla, že používa ochutené malé cigary. Šesť štátov – Florida, Georgia, Maryland, Massachusetts, Rhode Island a Wisconsin – má mieru fajčenia cigár u mladistvých rovnakú alebo vyššiu ako je miera fajčenia cigariet u mladistvých. Napriek vyhláseniam tabakového priemyslu je spojenie medzi marketingom a užívaním tabaku u mladistvých jasné. Niektoré legislatívne a regulačné opatrenia zamerané na riešenie daňových rozdielov, príťažlivosti pre mladých a marketingu sú zavedené alebo sa zvažujú. New York a Providence, Rhode Island, prijali celomestské nariadenia zakazujúce predaj ochutených tabakových výrobkov, vrátane ochutených malých cigár. Obe nariadenia boli napadnuté a potvrdené na Okresnom súde USA. V apríli bol v Senáte predložený zákon o daňovej a presadzovacej reforme tabaku, ktorého cieľom je odstrániť daňové rozdiely medzi rôznymi tabakovými výrobkami, znížiť nelegálny obchod s tabakom a zvýšiť federálnu spotrebnú daň z tabakových výrobkov. Na základe desaťročí dôkazov správa generálneho chirurga z roku 2012 o užívaní tabaku u mládeže a mladých dospelých dospela k záveru, že marketing tabakového priemyslu spôsobuje fajčenie mládeže a závislosť od nikotínu ich udržiava vo fajčení. Táto triezva skutočnosť platí aj napriek zákazom reklamy a propagačných akcií zameraných na deti a mládež a obmedzeniam určitých iných marketingových aktivít. Takmer 90 % fajčiarov začalo pred dovŕšením 18 rokov a takmer nikto nezačne fajčiť po 25. roku života. Aby sme predišli zbytočnej smrti, invalidite a chorobám spôsobeným fajčením, musíme zabrániť mladým ľuďom, aby vôbec začali fajčiť. Kľúčovou súčasťou preventívnych opatrení musí byť činnosť, ktorá odstráni medzery v obmedzeniach marketingu, cien a produktov tabaku, ktoré povzbudzujú deti a mládež k fajčeniu. Nie je príliš veľa očakávať od našej spoločnosti, aby sme chránili naše deti, aby mohli dosiahnuť dospelosť bez závislosti, ktorá im môže ublížiť alebo zabiť. Prieskum CDC zistil, že 'nové' tabakové výrobky získavajú na popularite medzi mladými ľuďmi. Vyjadrené názory sú výlučne názormi Dr. Toma Friedena.

article_content: Ronald Koeman isn't dwelling on Southampton's growing injury concerns, but his frustration with the congested fixture schedule is clear. Southampton is enjoying their best position at this stage of a Premier League season, entering the weekend in third place following an impressive victory at Manchester United. Their Wednesday win at Ipswich also secured their spot in the FA Cup, but these victories have come at a cost. Toby Alderweireld, Morgan Schneiderlin, and Victor Wanyama have all sustained injuries in the past week. Koeman is particularly frustrated by Wanyama's injury, a hamstring strain suffered during the FA Cup replay at Portman Road, sidelining the Kenyan midfielder for a month. Koeman questions the need for the replay itself. 'I don't focus too much on the problem of injuries because it's beyond my control,' Koeman stated. 'You can analyze training sessions and player recovery methods, but we haven't had proper training time recently because of the frequent games.' 'The schedule is problematic, especially during what should be a winter break. We are forced to play. Another replay? Seriously? The FA Cup should use extra time and penalties. Why have a replay? It's just another game – it's illogical.' Southampton's win against Manchester United at Old Trafford lifted them to third in the Premier League. These new injuries compound existing problems with Jay Rodriguez and Sam Gallagher, as well as the absences of Maya Yoshida, Sadio Mane, and Emmanuel Mayuka due to international commitments. Koeman remains confident that Southampton can 'handle this' number of missing players, but acknowledges that his assessment would change if the list grows further. He will be able to include Eljero Elia against Newcastle this weekend, as he was ineligible for the Ipswich game. Jack Cork could also feature, having returned from injury with 45 minutes for the under-21s on Monday. Victor Wanyama's hamstring injury against Ipswich will keep him out for a month. Shane Long's performance against Ipswich, where his goal secured their cup progress, has also given Koeman food for thought. 'Shane showed his quality and confidence,' Koeman remarked. 'His confidence isn't the issue; he simply hasn't started the last few games. We need everyone, including Shane, and he needs to capitalize on his opportunities, as he did.' If Long plays, he may again be deployed on the wing, with Graziano Pelle likely leading the attack at Newcastle on Saturday evening. Alan Pardew's departure and reports of discontent at St James' Park might suggest this is an opportune moment to play the managerless Magpies, but Koeman isn't underestimating them. 'I don't believe there's ever a good or bad time to face a team,' Koeman said. 'Every match is unique.' 'They're playing at home, and they've suffered some defeats recently. Some fans will undoubtedly be unhappy about the 4-0 loss they experienced at Southampton. But we recognize that they are a strong team at home. They defeated Chelsea at home, so it's never easy to beat Southampton.'

Southampton si užíva svoju najlepšiu pozíciu v tejto fáze sezóny Premier League, keď vstupuje do víkendu na treťom mieste po pôsobivom víťazstve na ihrisku Manchestru United. 'Môžete analyzovať tréningové jednotky a metódy regenerácie hráčov, ale v poslednom čase sme nemali riadny tréningový čas kvôli preťaženosti zápasmi.' Prečo opakovaný zápas? Je to len ďalší zápas – je to nelogické.' Víťazstvo Southamptonu nad Manchestrom United na Old Trafford ich posunulo na tretie miesto v Premier League. Tieto nové zranenia zhoršujú existujúce problémy s Jayom Rodriguezom a Samom Gallagherom, ako aj absencie Mayu Yoshidu, Sadia Maneho a Emmanuela Mayuku kvôli reprezentačným povinnostiam. Koeman zostáva presvedčený, že Southampton 'zvládne' tento počet chýbajúcich hráčov, ale pripúšťa, že jeho hodnotenie by sa zmenilo, ak by sa tento zoznam ešte rozšíril. Jack Cork by sa tiež mohol objaviť, keďže sa vrátil po zranení a odohral 45 minút za tím do 21 rokov v pondelok. Zranenie hamstringu Victora Wanyamu v zápase proti Ipswichu ho vyradí na mesiac. Výkon Shana Longa v zápase proti Ipswichu, kde jeho gól zabezpečil postup v pohári, dal Koemanovi podnet na zamyslenie. 'Shane ukázal svoju kvalitu a sebavedomie,' poznamenal Koeman. 'Jeho sebavedomie nie je problém; jednoducho nebol v základnej zostave v posledných zápasoch. Potrebujeme každého, vrátane Shana, a on musí využiť svoje príležitosti, ako to urobil.' Ak bude Long hrať, opäť môže byť nasadený na krídle, pričom Graziano Pelle pravdepodobne povedie útok proti Newcastlu v sobotu večer. Odchod Alana Pardewa a správy o nespokojnosti v St James' Parku by mohli naznačovať, že toto je vhodná chvíľa na hru proti Newcastlu bez trénera, ale Koeman ich nepodceňuje. 'Nemyslím si, že existuje dobrý alebo zlý čas na to, aby sme čelili nejakému tímu,' povedal Koeman. 'Každý zápas je iný.' 'Hrajú doma a v poslednom čase utrpeli niekoľko prehier. Niektorí fanúšikovia budú určite nespokojní s prehrou 0:4, ktorú utrpeli v Southamptone. Ale uvedomujeme si, že sú doma silný tím. Doma porazili Chelsea, takže nikdy nie je ľahké poraziť Southampton.'

article_content: Colombian military planes attacked hidden rebel camps over the weekend, resulting in the deaths of at least 20 members of the country's largest guerrilla group. The operation took place just days after negotiators completed a round of peace talks. Gen. Mario Valencia reported that a leading figure within the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) was among those killed in the airstrikes. Valencia informed reporters of this on Monday. For more details, see: Five facts about Colombia's FARC rebels. The FARC leader, known as 'Guillermo Pequeno' (Little Guillermo), had been a member of the leftist rebel group for 25 years, Valencia stated. In July, the Colombian Defense Ministry had offered a 1 billion-peso ($550,000) reward for information leading to his capture. Military officials described the weekend operation as a significant setback for the FARC, which has been in conflict with the Colombian government since the 1960s. Further reading: Colombia, FARC rebels begin formal peace talks in Norway. The airstrikes occurred in Colombia's Narino department, one day after President Juan Manuel Santos set a November 2013 deadline for the ongoing peace negotiations with the rebels, scheduled to resume on Friday. 'This process cannot take years, but months... It is important to be patient and not demand immediate results,' Santos said on Saturday. Last week, negotiators from both sides concluded their initial round of discussions and expressed measured optimism regarding the potential for a future peace agreement. Read more: FARC ready to lay down arms if government does. Last month, the FARC announced a temporary cessation of hostilities against government forces as a goodwill gesture. However, the following day, rebels detonated two electricity towers in Colombia, as reported by CNN affiliate Caracol TV. The guerrillas later stated that they carried out the attack because they were unaware of the cease-fire, according to Caracol TV. In September, Santos told CNN that the government would not participate in a cease-fire during negotiations. Santos stated, 'I've told them there will be a cease-fire and we will stop any military operation when we reach a final agreement. And if I see that there's no progress, that they are simply trying to buy time, I will stand up and continue business as usual. And that's why there's no cease-fire, no decrease in our military operations, and my government agenda will continue as it was until then.' Since the 1980s, there have been intermittent attempts at peace between FARC rebels and government officials. The most recent attempt collapsed in 2002. Then-President Andres Pastrana ceded an area the size of Switzerland to the rebel group, but ended negotiations after the rebels launched a series of attacks across the country, seemingly to strengthen their position. A new round of peace talks is scheduled to commence in Havana, Cuba, on Friday. CNN's Patrick Oppmann contributed to this report.
translated_content: Kolumbijské vojenské lietadlá cez víkend zaútočili na skryté povstalecké tábory, čo viedlo k smrti najmenej 20 členov najväčšej gerilovej skupiny v krajine. Operácia sa uskutočnila len niekoľko dní po tom, čo vyjednávači ukončili kolo mierových rozhovorov. Generál Mario Valencia uviedol, že popredný predstaviteľ Revolučných ozbrojených síl Kolumbie (FARC) bol medzi zabitými pri náletoch. Valencia o tom informoval novinárov v pondelok. Viac podrobností nájdete tu: Päť faktov o kolumbijských povstalcoch FARC. Vodca FARC, známy ako 'Guillermo Pequeno' (Malý Guillermo), bol členom ľavicovej povstaleckej skupiny 25 rokov, uviedol Valencia. V júli kolumbijské ministerstvo obrany ponúklo odmenu 1 miliardu pesos (550 000 dolárov) za informácie vedúce k jeho zajatiu. Vojenskí predstavitelia opísali víkendovú operáciu ako významný neúspech pre FARC, ktoré sú v konflikte s kolumbijskou vládou od 60. rokov 20. storočia. Ďalšie informácie: Kolumbia, povstalci FARC začínajú formálne mierové rozhovory v Nórsku. Nalety sa uskutočnili v kolumbijskom departemente Narino, deň po tom, čo prezident Juan Manuel Santos stanovil termín na november 2013 pre prebiehajúce mierové rokovania s povstalcami, ktoré majú pokračovať v piatok. 'Tento proces nemôže trvať roky, ale mesiace... Je dôležité byť trpezlivý a nežiadať okamžité výsledky,' povedal Santos v sobotu. Minulý týždeň vyjednávači z oboch strán ukončili svoje úvodné kolo diskusií a vyjadrili umiernený optimizmus ohľadom potenciálu budúcej mierovej dohody. Viac informácií: FARC sú pripravené zložiť zbrane, ak to urobí aj vláda. Minulý mesiac FARC oznámili dočasné zastavenie nepriateľských akcií proti vládnym silám ako gesto dobrej vôle. Nasledujúci deň však povstalci vyhodili do vzduchu dve elektrické veže v Kolumbii, ako uviedla CNN pobočka Caracol TV. Gerily neskôr uviedli, že útok vykonali preto, lebo si neboli vedomé prímeria, uviedla Caracol TV. V septembri Santos pre CNN povedal, že vláda sa počas rokovaní nezúčastní na prímerí. Santos uviedol: 'Povedal som im, že bude prímerie a zastavíme akúkoľvek vojenskú operáciu, keď dosiahneme konečnú dohodu. A ak uvidím, že nedochádza k žiadnemu pokroku, že sa jednoducho snažia získať čas, postavím sa a budem pokračovať v bežnej činnosti. A preto neexistuje žiadne prímerie, žiadne zníženie našich vojenských operácií a moja vládna agenda bude pokračovať tak, ako doteraz.' Od 80. rokov 20. storočia sa vyskytli občasné pokusy o mier medzi povstalcami FARC a vládnymi úradníkmi. Posledný pokus stroskotal v roku 2002. Vtedajší prezident Andres Pastrana postúpil povstaleckej skupine oblasť veľkú ako Švajčiarsko, ale ukončil rokovania po tom, čo povstalci začali sériu útokov po celej krajine, zrejme s cieľom posilniť svoju pozíciu. Nové kolo mierových rozhovorov sa má začať v piatok v Havane na Kube. Do tejto správy prispel Patrick Oppmann zo CNN.
